title: Growth Marketer In Global Running Company – Part-Time With Room To Grow Into Head Of Marketing
description:
Growth Marketer In Global Running Company – Part‑Time With Room To Grow Into Head Of Marketing

Join to apply for the Growth Marketer In Global Running Company – Part‑Time With Room To Grow Into Head Of Marketing role at Go! Running Tours .Get AI‑powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Hi, my name is Lena, and I am the founder of Go! Running Tours. This is not your usual job post. Instead of writing a fast‑paced, bullet‑pointed post with the words driven, team player, high performer, etc., I thought I would give it a go at simply writing the good, the bad, and the ugly about being a Growth Marketer with Go! Running Tours.

Your marketing DNA has to be the rare kind that is analytical and structured, while also having the creativity to craft great copy, see new opportunities, and connect the dots between B2C and B2B. I am looking for a colleague who works systematically with new ideas and markets, has attention to detail, and gets super excited about the responsibility you are given and the fact that the world is your marketing playground.

You’ll be working on a newsletter and pling!

  • an email lands in your inbox from Brooks, Lululemon, or Abbott World Marathon Majors.
Other times, results come from your structured and clever efforts over time. Not because we got it right the first time, but because we kept on researching, learning, testing and voilà: now you nailed it!

Our clients include US Bank, Goldman Sachs, Amex, Google, Accenture and runners of equal awesomeness from all over the world. We also work with some of the biggest names in the running industry (NDA signed) and in the future, with your help, many more.

I am looking for someone in constant growth mode: growth in terms of always looking for new opportunities to grow the business;
growth in terms of testing an initiative in one city and then scaling it to the rest of our destinations;
growth in terms of taking the time to research new tech, new ways of doing things, and current trends. Email marketing is a strong channel of ours, and if you get a thrill from optimising flows, building smart automations, and digging into data to make things work better and smarter, then this is your playground. We already send regular newsletters that do well, BUT someone with a data/automation mindset who puts their Sherlock Holmes hat on will, without a doubt, be able to optimise this tremendously.

We also own our digital advertising efforts. That means planning and running campaigns on Meta and Google, exploring new platforms, and keeping an eye on what actually moves the needle. We don't throw spaghetti at the wall here: we test, learn, and scale what works. You’ll also get to create clever case studies, explore sponsorship opportunities, and pitch bold ideas that help us reach new runners, new companies, and new destinations. If you spot a gap, we want you to fill it (and we’ll back you while you do).

You will be working directly with me in the role. I love my job, and every day I am utterly grateful that I work in a company with a concept that "makes sense" to me, and with colleagues who are skilled, helpful, and positive. I love running, and I have the pleasure of working with runners from all over the world and together, we cater for the best customer group in the world: runners!

People may find me difficult to work with, as I am impatient, I focus radically on progress, and I dislike sloppiness (with a passion). Most people, I believe (or at least hope), also find me kind, fun, optimistic, trusting, and understanding.

We work remotely and have only 2–3 hours of internal meetings a week. All other time is reserved for deep work and basically getting things done. There is always time for a call, and we are all on Slack, so you’re never left alone in any way.

The salary is not one that will secure you a Ferrari or a holiday to Mauritius (at least not to begin with). It is a salary that should be comfortable and is based on reduced working hours, so you can have a fun and fulfilling life besides work. The Money Should Not Be The Main Motivation For You – Running, Bridging Cultures, And Being Part Of a Fun, Fast‑moving, And Positive Company Should. The Contract Details Are As Follows:

  • USD 1,400 a month
  • 25 hrs a week
  • Managed via Upwork

Oh, and hey… if you’re considering this role as an add‑on to an already existing full‑time job, then hold your horses. I don’t believe in my colleagues working 60+ hours a week, and it simply doesn’t align with our company values. We want you to have the energy, focus, and headspace to do great work and enjoy life outside of it. The most important traits to bring to the role are being a fast mover, a super collaborator, and having a drive to grow… the business and yourself. But the most important skill of all is: execution. If we don’t execute, we can’t move the needle. That’s it, I think.

If you feel this role could be for you, then please write to me a short spiel on why you feel you’re right for the role and why you would like to work at Go! Running Tours (no AI please – we want to know the real you, not the ChatGPT version).

Thanks for reading this far.

Entry level

Part‑time

Marketing and Sales

title: Head De Marketing
description:
Head de Marketing A GoNext, referência em Governança e Sucessão para grupos empresariais familiares, busca um(a) Head de Marketing com visão estratégica, forte orientação para resultados e domínio de marketing B2B para conduzir nossa próxima fase de expansão. Este(a) líder será responsável por posicionar a GoNext como a principal autoridade do Brasil em governança corporativa para empresas familiares, fortalecer nossa presença nacional e impulsionar a geração de demanda qualificada para o time comercial.

Estratégia de Marketing e Posicionamento
  • Definir e executar o plano estratégico de marketing da GoNext, alinhado ao crescimento da companhia.
  • Consolidar o posicionamento da marca como referência em governança, sucessão e estratégia para grupos empresariais familiares.
Geração de Demanda e Suporte Comercial
  • Estruturar funnels de aquisição (digitais e offline) orientados ao público decisor: acionistas, presidentes, diretores e famílias empresárias.
  • Conduzir campanhas que resultem em oportunidades qualificadas (MQLs / SQLs) para o time comercial.
Construção e Fortalecimento da Marca
  • Desenvolver narrativas institucionais que reforcem a credibilidade, o histórico de mais de 300 projetos e a metodologia proprietária.
  • Garantir consistência da marca em todos os canais, eventos e materiais.
Conteúdo de Alto Impacto (Thought Leadership)
  • Liderar a produção de conteúdos estratégicos (artigos, estudos, vídeos, podcasts, reports e cases).
  • Expandir a presença da marca com foco em autoridade, educação do mercado e diferenciação.
Digital, Dados e Inteligência de Mercado
  • Estruturar um marketing data-driven, com análise contínua de indicadores, CAC, ROI e performance de campanhas.
  • Mapear tendências de governança, mercado B2B e movimentos de concorrentes para orientar decisões.
Gestão de Canais, Mídias e Parceiros
  • Coordenar agências, assessoria de imprensa, performance e fornecedores.
  • Expandir presença digital em redes sociais, LinkedIn e plataformas estratégicas.
Lançamento de Produtos e Novas Soluções
  • Liderar lançamentos da vertical de tecnologia, educação executiva e serviços escaláveis.
  • Estruturar precificação, narrativa de valor e estratégia go-to-market.
Perfil Desejado
  • Experiência sólida em marketing B2B, preferencialmente em consultorias, serviços profissionais ou empresas de alta complexidade.
  • Forte domínio de estratégias digitais, posicionamento, geração de demanda e marketing de conteúdo.
  • Perfil analítico, inovador, com capacidade de execução ágil e visão de negócio.
  • Excelente comunicação executiva e habilidade de dialogar com níveis C-Level, conselhos e famílias empresárias.
Benefícios e Condições

Modelo: Tempo integral
Regime: A combinar
Local: Curitiba (PR)
Remuneração: Competitiva e alinhada ao mercado

Se você deseja liderar o marketing de uma marca consolidada, em crescimento acelerado e com forte propósito empresarial, envie seu contato e venha construir o próximo capítulo da GoNext.

title: Growth Marketer In Global Running Company – Part-Time With Room To Grow Into Head Of Marketing
description:
Growth Marketer – Part‑time (Opportunity to Lead Marketing)

Go! Running Tours, a global company bringing adventure to runners worldwide, is looking for a Growth Marketer who will drive the marketing strategy across both B2C and B2B channels.

Job Overview

As our Growth Marketer you will be the full‑stack marketing leader: from email and newsletter optimisation to paid media and partnership outreach. You will work closely with the founder, maintain a data‑driven mindset, and scale initiatives from one city to the rest of our destinations.

Responsibilities
  • Strategically plan, launch, and optimise email marketing flows – newsletters, automation, and segmentation for a global audience.
  • Drive paid media campaigns on Meta and Google, test new platforms, and track performance metrics that matter.
  • Research and identify new growth channels, markets, and technology opportunities to expand our reach.
  • Create case studies, sponsor collaborations, and pitch bold concepts that extend our brand into new segments.
  • Analyse data, run experiments, and iterate quickly to validate and scale high‑impact tactics.
  • Collaborate remotely with a distributed team, keeping meetings concise while ensuring clarity and alignment.
Qualifications
  • Strong analytical skills combined with creative copywriting and design chops.
  • Experience managing email marketing campaigns, preferably with automation platforms.
  • Proven track record in paid media (Meta, Google, and proficiency in measuring ROI).
  • Growth mindset: constant learning, experimentation, and scaling of successful pilots.
  • Excellent attention to detail, fast execution, and ability to thrive in a remote, low‑meeting environment.
  • Self‑motivated, collaborative, and eager to grow the business and your own career.
Compensation & Benefits

USD 1,400 per month, 25 hours per week, with Upwork contracting.

The role is part‑time, flexible, and hosted on a remote basis. No expectation of more than 25 hours weekly;
the focus is on result‑driven output rather than overtime.

Additional Information

The posting is active for 3–4 days. If you are a full‑time employee and interested in a supplemental role, please note that the company values balance and will not allow 60+ hour commitments.

We ask applicants to submit a brief spiel explaining why you are a good fit, and why you want to join Go! Running Tours (no AI submissions). Let’s build a fun, high‑energy, and positive team together.

I love running, and I have the pleasure of working with runners from all over the world and together, we cater for the best customer group in the world: runners! title: Medical Science Liaison
description:
Job Description

Our Medical Affairs team advances patient care by engaging in scientific exchange with external medical experts and industry professionals ensuring the scientific value of our products is realized. We engage and train internal employees to ensure that they thoroughly comprehend the science behind the medicine and review further unmet medical needs to bolster collaboration and further differentiate our portfolio.

Description

MSL (Medical Scientific Liaisons) are scientifically trained and credentialed therapeutic area disease and product experts who engage in non-promotional scientific exchange with Scientific Leaders or Key Decision Makers. MSL interactions with Scientific Leaders and Key Decision Makers are built on the credibility of the scientific exchange held. MSLs (Medical Scientific Liaisons) develop and execute on action plans aligned with the Guiding Principles for example US Global Medical Affairs / Oncology Global Medical Affairs External Stakeholder-Facing Activities local and global company policies local rules & regulations and the Medical Affairs Plan (MAP).

Responsibilities

The MSL (Medical Scientific Liaisons) is responsible for ensuring that he / she is fully versed in the therapeutic area and up to date on all major studies both ongoing and completed product information on our company and other companies relevant therapies clinical data and relevant pipeline data to provide the most balanced data to Scientific Leaders Key Decision Makers and the healthcare community to improve patient care.

Requirements

Bachelors degree in Life Sciences;

Masters or PhD in cardiology pulmonology or related areas will be considered a differential;

Advanced English;

Ability to interpret data and scientific articles;

Travel is a requirement.

Benefits

We are a research-driven biopharmaceutical company. Our mission is built on the simple premise that if we follow the science that great medicines can make a significant impact to our world. We believe that a research-driven enterprise dedicated to world-class science can succeed by inventing medicine and vaccine innovations that make a difference for patients across the globe.

title: Medical Science Liaison, Metabolics
description:
Why Join Us

Be a hero for our rare disease patients

At Ultragenyx we fundamentally believe that taking real impactful action to care for the needs of patients and our people is always the right thing to achieve this goal our vision is to lead the future of rare disease medicine. For us this means going where other biopharma companies wont go challenging the status quo and creating a new model that advances our field so more patients and caregivers can benefit from life-changing treatments. We do this by following the science applying a novel rapid development approach making innovative medicines at fair and reasonable prices and creating a collaborative ecosystem to reach patients in ways that are most meaningful for them.

Our commitment and care for patients extends to our people so culture is an essential cornerstone for Ulyx. We remain continuously focused on creating a supportive and inclusive environment of profound learning and growth so employees can thrive in all areas of their lives in and outside of we want to be an organization where we would be proud for our family friends and children to work.

If you want to have a meaningful impact do the best work of your career and grow a lot both professionally andpersonally come join our team .

Position Summary

ultra innovative Tackle rare and dynamic challenges

The Medical Science Liaison (MSL) is a member of a field-based team of scientists who function as an extension of the Medical Affairs organization. MSLs are responsible for developing and enhancing professional relationships with medical thought leaders involved in various phases of product development as well as key medical organizations including treatment centers of excellence and established societies and associations. MSLs provide medical information through scientific exchange in a fair-balanced manner and provide clinical / scientific support to the company.

The MSL will help to integrate the efforts of the Medical Affairs Department with R&D Clinical Affairs and Scientific Affairs and with other internal teams to ensure effective selection and execution of investigator-initiated clinical trials. The incumbent will also provide clinical and educational support to managed care organizations as well as identify influential senior clinicians on the national and regional level.

This is a field-based position based out of Porto Alegre or Curitiba and requires professionals with established personal and scientific creditability to interact with thought leaders and centers of excellence. This MSL position will support companys products in development and brands as their primary responsibility. The ideal candidate will possess an understanding of rare diseases development.

Work Model

Field : Officially documented as working as a member of the Ultragenyx field team based out of Rio Grande do Sul or Puraná generally interacting with third parties on behalf of Ultragenyx.

Responsibilities
  • Identify Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) and establish and maintain scientific relationships with KOLs;
    connecting to KOLs in academic and community centers
  • Using the science behind our products supports treatment for patients with rare and ultra-rare diseases
  • Act as primary liaison to investigators interested in developing and performing investigator-initiated research
  • Develop and execute territory plans in alignment with country-level plans
  • Provide clinical presentations and medical information in response to unsolicited questions (as appropriate) in academic community and healthcare provider settings
  • Provide medical information through scientific exchange and disseminate scientific publications
  • Provide clinical disease state presentations to key stakeholders including Payers
  • Collaborate with the Clinical Operations organization to enhance patient enrolment in company-sponsored clinical trials by identifying appropriate clinical trial sites and interacting with investigators in ongoing studies
  • Provide Scientific and Medical information updates
  • Provide scientific support at medical congresses
  • Provide timely medical insights / information on emerging clinical / scientific teams and opportunities to internal stakeholders
  • Provide scientific support for appropriate educational initiatives
  • Ensure all activities are compliant with company policies and SOPs
  • Seek out opportunities to support the MSL value proposition achieve results and set an example for others to follow by consistently demonstrating Ultragenyx cultural attributes and core competencies
  • Be compliant with Ultragenyx Code of Conduct policies and procedures
Requirements
  • Medical Doctor (2 years of MSL experience desirable)
  • Advanced written and spoken level of English
  • Rare disease experience preferred particularly in metabolic genetic diseases
  • Excellent teamwork and communication skills required
  • Demonstrated experience effectively presenting clinical / scientific information required
  • Expert understanding of the local health care delivery system and its impact on patient care and regional medical care
  • Models our Core Values #Dynamic #Possibility #Generous #Relentness #Courageous and is experienced as someone who exemplifies the culture we want to create;
    operates with transparency;
    is trusted
  • Ability to relate and work with a wide range of people to achieve results
  • Ability to organize and prioritize own work schedule
  • Ability to make decisions which have a significant impact on the departments credibility operations and services
  • Ability to create materials such as reports presentations for inside and outside the organization and present / speak to groups
  • Time and territory management skills required
  • Approximately 50-60% of travel is required;
    overnight travel is required as needed

title: Medical Science Liaison
description:
Career CategoryMedical AffairsJob Description

JUNTE-SE À MISSÃO DA AMGEN DE SERVIR AOS PACIENTES Na Amgen, se você sente que faz parte de algo maior, é porque realmente faz.

Nossa missão compartilhada — servir aos pacientes que vivem com doenças graves — impulsiona tudo o que fazemos.Desde

  • temos sido pioneiros no mundo da biotecnologia em nossa luta contra as doenças mais difíceis do mundo.

Com nosso foco em quatro áreas terapêuticas — Oncologia, Inflamação, Medicina Geral e Doenças Raras — alcançamos milhões de pacientes a cada ano.

Como membro da equipe Amgen, você ajudará a causar um impacto duradouro na vida dos pacientes enquanto pesquisamos, fabricamos e entregamos medicamentos inovadores para ajudar as pessoas a viverem vidas mais longas, plenas e felizes.

Nosso cultura premiada é colaborativa, inovadora e baseada na ciência.

Se você tem paixão por desafios e pelas oportunidades que eles oferecem, você prosperará como parte da equipe Amgen.

Junte-se a nós e transforme a vida dos pacientes enquanto transforma sua carreira.

Medical Science Liaison

O Medical Science Liaison é um profissional altamente qualificado da indústria farmacêutica, responsável por estabelecer uma relação científica com médicos e especialistas da área.

Atua como um ponto de contato entre a Amgen e os profissionais de saúde, com foco em oferecer informações científicas detalhadas, dados clínicos, apoio para a utilização adequada de medicamentos e coleta de insights importantes para a estratégia médica da área terapêutica.

Sede da vaga : São Paulo.

É necessário ter disponibilidade para viagens (60%).

80% da atuação nesta vaga será em campo.

Responsabilidades principais

Construir e Manter Relacionamentos Científicos: Estabelecer uma rede de contatos com líderes de opinião chave (KOLs) e outros profissionais de saúde para discutir dados clínicos e avanços terapêuticos.

Educação Científica: Fornecer apresentações científicas detalhadas sobre a doença e os produtos e pesquisas atuais para médicos, profissionais da saúde, hospitais e grupos de saúde.

Suporte Clínico: fornecer feedback de especialistas da área sobre os produtos.

Apoio às Equipes Internas: Trabalhar de perto com equipes de marketing, vendas e acesso para garantir a precisão das informações científicas e apoiar no desenvolvimento de estratégias.

Desenvolver e Realizar Treinamentos: Realizar sessões de treinamento interno e externos para garantir que as partes interessadas compreendam os aspectos científicos dos produtos e áreas terapêuticas.

Avaliar e Coletar Feedback Clínicos e de Mercado: Identificar tendências no tratamento de doenças e novas necessidades no mercado, proporcionando insights valiosos para a estratégia da empresa.

O que esperamos de você

Somos todos diferentes, mas usamos nossas contribuições únicas para servir aos pacientes.

O profissional qualificado que buscamos é um Medical Science Liaison, com as seguintes qualificações:

Qualificações Básicas

Doutorado OU Mestrado + 3 anos de experiência em Assuntos Médicos OU Bacharelado + 5 anos de experiência em Assuntos Médicos.

Qualificações Desejáveis

Formação acadêmica: Graduação completa em área relacionada à saúde (Medicina, Farmácia, Biomedicina, Enfermagem, etc).

Mínimo de 2 anos de experiência como Medical Science Liaison (MSL) ou em posição similar na área de Assuntos Médicos.

Inglês avançado — essencial, espanhol — desejável.

Experiência ou conhecimento na área de Neurologia ou Doenças Raras será altamente valorizado.

Excelente comunicação científica.

Capacidade de construir relacionamento com líderes de opinião médica (KOLs).

Pensamento estratégico, perfil colaborativo e proativo.

O que você pode esperar de nós

Enquanto trabalhamos para desenvolver tratamentos que cuidam dos outros, também cuidamos do crescimento profissional e bem-estar pessoal de nossos colegas.

Além do salário base, a Amgen oferece pacotes de compensação competitivos e abrangentes, alinhados aos padrões da indústria local.

Como uma organização dedicada a melhorar a qualidade de vida das pessoas ao redor do mundo, a Amgen promove um ambiente inclusivo, com pessoas diversas, éticas, comprometidas e altamente qualificadas, que se respeitam mutuamente e vivem os valores da Amgen para continuar avançando na ciência a serviço dos pacientes.

Juntos, competimos na luta contra doenças graves.

A Amgen não discrimina em suas oportunidades de emprego com base em sexo, raça, cor, idade, nacionalidade, idéias políticas ou religiosas, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, nível e tipo deficiência, origem étnica ou qualquer outra categoria protegida por lei.

E fazemos um convite especial às pessoas que se autodeclaram pretas e pardas, LGBTQIAP+, possuem algum tipo de deficiência, tenham +50 anos e mulheres que buscam por posições de liderança, para que conheçam mais sobre a Amgen e nossas oportunidades de carreira, pois temos como compromisso gerar oportunidades para grupos minorizados e criar um ambiente cada vez mais diverso e inclusivo.

Garantiremos que pessoas com deficiência recebam acomodações razoáveis para participar do processo de candidatura ou entrevista, para desempenhar funções essenciais do cargo e para receber outros benefícios e privilégios de emprego.

Sobre a Tereos Com visão de longo prazo no processamento de matérias-primas agrícolas e desenvolvimento de produtos alimentícios de qualidade, a Tereos é uma das líderes nos mercados de açúcar, álcool/etanol e amidos. Tereos no Brasil A Tereos no Brasil é composta pela Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil, Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil e Tereos Commodities Brasil. No noroeste do Estado de São Paulo, a Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil concentra suas sete unidades de processamento e duas refinarias. A Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil, com operação em Palmital (SP), diversifica o portfólio da Tereos Brasil com a fabricação de produtos derivados de milho.   • Gerenciar Processos Judiciais e Administrativos: Auxiliar na condução e acompanhamento de processos jurídicos da empresa, elaborando peças processuais simples (como contestações e recursos) sob supervisão;

    e registrar todas as informações no sistema RR Juridico, assegurando o cumprimento dos prazos legais e garantindo a defesa dos interesses da empresa;
  • Elaborar e Revisar Contratos: Redigir e revisar contratos diversos, como os de prestação de serviços e representação comercial, analisando cláusulas contratuais, propondo alterações para garantir a conformidade com normas legais e políticas internas, a fim de mitigar riscos jurídicos e assegurar que os acordos firmados estejam em conformidade com a legislação;
  • Prevenir Riscos Jurídicos: Realizar pesquisas legais e análises preventivas, jurisprudência, legislação aplicável e possíveis implicações jurídicas em decisões estratégicas, antecipando os riscos legais e protegendo a empresa de possíveis litígios ou penalidades;
  • Apoiar a Área de Compliance e Regulatório: Colaborar na implementação e no monitoramento de políticas de compliance e conformidade regulatória, participando da construção de programas internos, revisando políticas da empresa e acompanhando obrigações legais específicas do setor fabril, garantindo que as operações estejam de acordo com as normas legais e regulatórias, evitando sanções e promovendo práticas éticas;
  • Participar de Reuniões e Fornecer Suporte Jurídico: Atuar como apoio jurídico em decisões empresariais e projetos internos;
    participar de reuniões interdepartamentais, analisando aspectos legais das iniciativas da empresa e fornecendo pareceres quando necessário, assegurando que todas as decisões estejam alinhadas com a legislação para mitigação dos riscos jurídicos;
  • Gerenciar Documentos Legais: Organizar e manter os documentos jurídicos da empresa, classificando e arquivando registros atualizados no sistema RRJuridico, garantindo acessibilidade e segurança para manter a rastreabilidade e facilitar o acesso rápido às informações;
  • Solicitar e Consolidar Pareceres Jurídicos: Solicitar pareceres e levantar informações necessárias para instruir decisões jurídicas, reunindo dados de diferentes áreas, organizando informações e encaminhando solicitações para advogados internos, apoiando decisões estratégicas com embasamento legal sólido;
  • Assegurar Conformidade com Normas Internas e Externas: Analisar os procedimentos internos sob a ótica legal, revisando políticas, práticas e normas internas para garantir conformidade com legislações aplicáveis e diretrizes do grupo empresarial;
  • Manter Organização e Segurança do Ambiente de Trabalho: Organizar o espaço de trabalho conforme padrões estabelecidos, seguindo normas de qualidade, segurança do trabalho e preservação ambiental, para promover um ambiente profissional eficiente, seguro e sustentável.

Hoje, seguimos crescendo e nos transformando a cada dia, ao lado de mais de 50 mil pessoas colaboradoras. São elas que nos tornam a Melhor Empresa Para Trabalhar, ocupando novamente a primeira posição, segundo o Great Place To Work Brasil (GPTW).

Junto a mais de 9 milhões de associados, em todos os estados do país, acreditamos no poder da cooperação para construir uma sociedade mais próspera e gerar impacto positivo na vida das pessoas. Um propósito que nos une e nos inspira, promovendo o desenvolvimento local e sustentável, a educação e a inclusão financeira.

Seguimos buscando talentos que queiram fazer parte da construção de um mundo melhor e queremos contar com você. #VemSerSicredi!

title: Growth Marketer In Global Running Company – Part-Time With Room To Grow Into Head Of Marketing
description:
Growth Marketer In Global Running Company – Part-Time With Room To Grow Into Head Of Marketing

3 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Hi... My name is Lena, and I am the founder of Go! Running Tours. This is not your usual job post. Instead of writing a fast-paced, bullet-pointed post with the words driven, team player, high performer, etc., I thought I would give it a go at simply writing the good, the bad, and the ugly about being a Growth Marketer with Go! Running Tours. Maybe no one will reply. Maybe many will. I just need one really good one! So let’s start. Our new Growth Marketer will be responsible for all our marketing activities for B2C and B2B clients. Our current markets are growing (some by 100+%) and we are constantly looking for new channels and markets to sell our services. Your marketing DNA has to be of the rare kind that is analytical and structured, while also having the creativity to craft great copy, see new opportunities, and connect the dots between B2C and B2B. I am looking for a colleague who works systematically with new ideas and markets, has attention to detail, and gets super excited about the responsibility you are given and the fact that the world is your marketing playground. We are lucky that sometimes amazing opportunities (that - if you are a runner and marketeer - probably will make you do cartwheels) land in our turban. You’ll be working on a newsletter and pling!

  • an email lands in your inbox from Brooks, or Lululemon, or Abbott World Marathon Majors.
Whoop whoop! Other times, results come from your structured and clever efforts over time. Not because we got it right the first time, but because we kept on researching, learning, testing and voilà: now you nailed it! Our clients include US Bank, Goldman Sachs, Amex, Google, Accenture and runners of equal awesomeness from all over the world! We also work with some of the biggest names in the running industry (NDA signed) and in the future, with your help, many more...Right? I am looking for someone in constant growth mode. Growth in terms of always looking for new opportunities to grow the business. Growth in terms of testing an initiative in one city and then scaling it to the rest of our destinations. Growth in terms of taking the time to research new tech, new ways of doing things, and current trends. Email marketing is a strong channel of ours, and if you get a thrill from optimising flows, building smart automations, and digging into data to make things work better and smarter, then this is your playground. We already send regular newsletters that do well, BUT someone with a data/automation mindset who puts their Sherlock Holmes hat on will, without a doubt, be able to optimise this tremendously. And have loads of fun with it. I personally love testing new ideas, so know that you'll have me and colleagues from all over the world cheering you on every step of the way. You’ll also own our digital advertising efforts. That means planning and running campaigns on Meta and Google, exploring new platforms, and keeping an eye on what actually moves the needle. We don't throw spaghetti at the wall here: we test, learn, and scale what works. You'll also get to create clever case studies, explore sponsorship opportunities, and pitch bold ideas that help us reach new runners, new companies, and new destinations. If you spot a gap, we want you to fill it (and we’ll back you while you do). You will be working directly with me in the role. I love my job, and every day I am utterly grateful that I work in a company with a concept that "makes sense" to me, and with colleagues who are skilled, helpful, and positive. I love running, and I have the pleasure of working with runners from all over the world and together, we cater for the best customer group in the world: runners! Some people may find me difficult to work with, as I am impatient, I focus radically on progress, and I dislike sloppiness (with a passion). Most people, I believe (or at least hope), also find me kind, fun, optimistic, trusting, and understanding (admittedly still very little understanding for sloppiness ;
-)). My guess is that ifyou are good at what you do and eager to excel in this role, we will end up best buddies! We work remotely and have only 2–3 hours of internal meetings a week. All other time is reserved for deep work and basically getting things done. There is always time for a call, and we are all on Slack, so you’re never left alone in any way. We’re just on the other side of the world. The salary is not one that will secure you a Ferrari or a holiday to Mauritius (at least not to begin with). It is a salary that should be comfortable and is based on reduced working hours, so you can have a fun and fulfilling life besides work. The Money Should Not Be The Main Motivation For You - Running, Bridging Cultures, And Being Part Of a Fun, Fast-moving, And Positive Company Should.The Contract Details Are As Follows USD 1,400 a month 25 hrs a week Managed via UpworkOh, and hey... if you're considering this role as an add-on to an already existing full-time job, then hold your horses. I don't believe in my colleagues working 60+ hours a week, and it simply doesn't align with our company values. We want you to have the energy, focus, and headspace to do great work and enjoy life outside of it. The most important traits to bring to the role are being a fast mover, a super collaborator, and having a drive to grow... the business and yourself. But the most important skill of all is: execution. If we don't execute, we can't move the needle. That's it, I think. I've probably left out loads of super important things, but at least this gives you some idea. If you feel this role could be for you, then please write to me ****** w ith a short spiel on why you feel you're right for the role and why you would like to work at Go! Running Tours (no AI please - we want to know the real you, not the ChatGPT version ). Thanks for reading this far, LenaNote: we usually take down our job posts within 3-4 days as we receive many applicants.Seniority level

Join to apply for the Growth Marketer In Global Running Company - Part-Time With Room To Grow Into Head Of Marketing role at Go! Running Tours

Hi... My name is Lena, and I am the founder of Go! Running Tours. This is not your usual job post. Instead of writing a fast-paced, bullet-pointed post with the words driven, team player, high performer, etc., I thought I would give it a go at simply writing the good, the bad, and the ugly about being a Growth Marketer with Go! Running Tours.

Our new Growth Marketer will be responsible for all our marketing activities for B2C and B2B clients. Our current markets are growing (some by 100+%) and we are constantly looking for new channels and markets to sell our services. Your marketing DNA has to be of the rare kind that is analytical and structured, while also having the creativity to craft great copy, see new opportunities, and connect the dots between B2C and B2B. I am looking for a colleague who works systematically with new ideas and markets, has attention to detail, and gets super excited about the responsibility you are given and the fact that the world is your marketing playground.

We are lucky that sometimes amazing opportunities (that - if you are a runner and marketeer - probably will make you do cartwheels) land in our turban. You'll be working on a newsletter and pling!... an email lands in your inbox from Brooks, or Lululemon, or Abbott World Marathon Majors. Whoop whoop!

Other times, results come from your structured and clever efforts over time. Not because we got it right the first time, but because we kept on researching, learning, testing and voilà: now you nailed it!

Our clients include US Bank, Goldman Sachs, Amex, Google, Accenture and runners of equal awesomeness from all over the world!

We also work with some of the biggest names in the running industry (NDA signed ) and in the future, with your help, many more...Right?

I am looking for someone in constant growth mode. Growth in terms of always looking for new opportunities to grow the business. Growth in terms of testing an initiative in one city and then scaling it to the rest of our destinations. Growth in terms of taking the time to research new tech, new ways of doing things, and current trends.

Email marketing is a strong channel of ours, and if you get a thrill from optimising flows, building smart automations, and digging into data to make things work better and smarter, then this is your playground. We already send regular newsletters that do well, BUT someone with a data/automation mindset who puts their Sherlock Holmes hat on will, without a doubt, be able to optimise this tremendously. And have loads of fun with it. I personally love testing new ideas, so know that you'll have me and colleagues from all over the world cheering you on every step of the way.

You will also own our digital advertising efforts. That means planning and running campaigns on Meta and Google, exploring new platforms, and keeping an eye on what actually moves the needle. We don't throw spaghetti at the wall here: we test, learn, and scale what works. You'll also get to create clever case studies, explore sponsorship opportunities, and pitch bold ideas that help us reach new runners, new companies, and new destinations. If you spot a gap, we want you to fill it (and we'll back you while you do).

You will be working directly with me in the role. I love my job, and every day I am utterly grateful that I work in a company with a concept that "makes sense" to me, and with colleagues who are skilled, helpful, and positive. I love running, and I have the pleasure of working with runners from all over the world and together, we cater for the best customer group in the world: runners!

Some people may find me difficult to work with, as I am impatient, I focus radically on progress, and I dislike sloppiness (with a passion). Most people, I believe (or at least hope), also find me kind, fun, optimistic, trusting, and understanding (admittedly still very little understanding for sloppiness ;
-)). My guess is that ifyou are good at what you do and eager to excel in this role, we will end up best buddies!

We work remotely and have only 2–3 hours of internal meetings a week. All other time is reserved for deep work and basically getting things done. There is always time for a call, and we are all on Slack, so you're never left alone in any way. We're just on the other side of the world.

The salary is not one that will secure you a Ferrari or a holiday to Mauritius (at least not to begin with). It is a salary that should be comfortable and is based on reduced working hours, so you can have a fun and fulfilling life besides work. The money should not be the main motivation for you - running, bridging cultures, and being part of a fun, fast-moving, and positive company should.

Contract Details

USD 1,400 a month

25 hrs a week

Managed via Upwork

Important Traits
  • Fast mover
  • Super collaborator
  • Drive to grow the business and yourself
  • Execution skill – if we don't execute, we can't move the needle

If you feel this role could be for you, then please write to me via ****** with a short spiel on why you feel you're right for the role and why you would like to work at Go! Running Tours (no AI please - we want to know the real you, not the ChatGPT version ).

Thanks for reading this far,

Lena

I am looking for a colleague who works systematically with new ideas and markets, has attention to detail, and gets super excited about the responsibility you are given and the fact that the world is your marketing playground. We are lucky that sometimes amazing opportunities (that – if you are a runner and marketeer – probably will make you do cartwheels) land in our turban. You’ll be working on a newsletter and pling! An email lands in your inbox from Brooks, or Lululemon, or Abbott World Marathon Majors. Other times, results come from your structured and clever efforts over time, not because we got it right the first time, but because we kept on researching, learning, testing and voilà: now you nailed it! Our clients include US Bank, Goldman Sachs, Amex, Google, Accenture and runners of equal awesomeness from all over the world. We also work with some of the biggest names in the running industry (NDA signed) and in the future, with your help, many more…right? I am looking for someone in constant growth mode. Growth in terms of always looking for new opportunities to grow the business. Growth in terms of testing an initiative in one city and then scaling it to the rest of our destinations. Growth in terms of taking the time to research new tech, new ways of doing things, and current trends. We already send regular newsletters that do well, but someone with a data/automation mindset who puts their Sherlock Holmes hat on will, without a doubt, be able to optimise this tremendously. And have loads of fun with it. I personally love testing new ideas, so know that you’ll have me and colleagues from all over the world cheering you on every step of the way. You’ll also own our digital advertising efforts. That means planning and running campaigns on Meta and Google, exploring new platforms, and keeping an eye on what actually moves the needle. We don’t throw spaghetti at the wall here: we test, learn, and scale what works. You’ll also get to create clever case studies, explore sponsorship opportunities, and pitch bold ideas that help us reach new runners, new companies, and new destinations. If you spot a gap, we want you to fill it (and we’ll back you while you do). You will be working directly with me in the role. I love my job, and every day I am utterly grateful that I work in a company with a concept that "makes sense" to me, and with colleagues who are skilled, helpful, and positive. I love running, and I have the pleasure of working with runners from all over the world and together, we cater for the best customer group in the world: runners! Some people may find me difficult to work with, as I am impatient, I focus radically on progress, and I dislike sloppiness (with a passion). Most people, I believe (or at least hope), also find me kind, fun, optimistic, trusting, and understanding (admittedly still very little understanding for sloppiness ;
-)). My guess is that ifyou are good at what you do and eager to excel in this role, we will end up best buddies! We work remotely and have only 2–3 hours of internal meetings a week. All other time is reserved for deep work and basically getting things done. There is always time for a call, and we are all on Slack, so you’re never left alone in any way. We’re just on the other side of the world. The salary is not one that will secure you a Ferrari or a holiday to Mauritius (at least not to begin with). It is a salary that should be comfortable and is based on reduced working hours, so you can have a fun and fulfilling life besides work. The Money Should Not Be The Main Motivation For You - Running, Bridging Cultures, And Being Part Of a Fun, Fast-moving, And Positive Company Should. The Contract Details Are As Follows: USD 1,400 a month, 25 hrs a week, managed via Upwork. Oh, and hey... if you’re considering this role as an add‑on to an already existing full‑time job, then hold your horses. I don’t believe in my colleagues working 60+ hours a week, and it simply doesn’t align with our company values. We want you to have the energy, focus, and headspace to do great work and enjoy life outside of it. The most important traits to to the role are being a fast mover, a super collaborator, and having a drive to grow... the business and yourself. But the most important skill of all is: execution. If we don’t execute, we can’t move the needle. That’s it, I think. I’ve probably left out loads of super important things, but at least this gives you some idea. title: Growth Marketer In Global Running Company – Part-Time With Room To Grow Into Head Of Marketing
description:
Growth Marketer In Global Running Company – Part‑Time With Room To Grow Into Head Of Marketing

Hi, my name is Lena, and I am the founder of Go! Running Tours. This is not your usual job post. I’ll give you the good, the bad, and the ugly about being a Growth Marketer with Go! Running Tours.

Our new Growth Marketer will be responsible for all our marketing activities for B2C and B2B clients. Our current markets are growing (some by 100+%) and we are constantly looking for new channels and markets to sell our services. Your marketing DNA must be analytical and structured, while also having the creativity to craft great copy, see new opportunities, and connect the dots between B2C and B2B.

I am looking for a colleague who works systematically with new ideas and markets, has attention to detail, and gets super excited about the responsibility you are given and the fact that the world is your marketing playground. You’ll be working on a newsletter, email flows, and more.

Other times, results come from your structured and clever efforts over time. Not because we got it right the first time, but because we kept on researching, learning, testing and voilà: now you nailed it! Our clients include US Bank, Goldman Sachs, Amex, Google, Accenture, and runners worldwide. We also work with some of the biggest names in the running industry (NDA signed) and in the future, with your help, many more…right?

I am looking for someone in constant growth mode — growth in terms of always looking for new opportunities to grow the business, testing an initiative in one city and then scaling it, researching new tech, and keeping an eye on trends. Email marketing is a strong channel of ours, and if you get a thrill from optimizing flows, building smart automations, and digging into data, this is your playground. We already send regular newsletters that do well, but someone with a data/automation mindset can optimize this tremendously.

You’ll also own our digital advertising efforts: planning and running campaigns on Meta and Google, exploring new platforms, and keeping an eye on what actually moves the needle. We test, learn, and scale what works. You’ll also create case studies, explore sponsorship opportunities, and pitch bold ideas that help us reach new runners, new companies, and new destinations.

We work remotely and have only 2–3 hours of internal meetings a week. All other time is reserved for deep work and basically getting things done. There is always time for a call, and we are all on Slack, so you’re never left alone in any way. We’re just on the other side of the world.

The Contract Details Are As Follows

  • USD 1,400 a month
  • 25 hrs a week
  • Managed via Upwork

The salary is not one that will secure you a Ferrari or a holiday to Mauritius (at least not to begin with). It is a salary that should be comfortable and is based on reduced working hours, so you can have a fun and fulfilling life besides work. The money should not be the main motivation for you—running, bridging cultures, and being part of a fun, fast‑moving, and positive company should.

Oh, and hey… if you’re considering this role as an add‑on to an already existing full‑time job, then hold your horses. I don’t believe in my colleagues working 60+ hours a week, and it simply doesn’t align with our company values. We want you to have the energy, focus, and headspace to do great work and enjoy life outside of it.

The most important traits to bring to the role are being a fast mover, a super collaborator, and having a drive to grow—the business and yourself. But the most important skill of all is: execution. If we don’t execute, we can’t move the needle.

If you feel this role could be for you, then please write to me via the contact provided with a short spiel on why you feel you’re right for the role and why you would like to work at Go! Running Tours. No AI please—we want to know the real you, not the ChatGPT version.

Thanks for reading this far,
Lena

title: Principal Ai Engineer - Ai In Healthcare
description:
WHO WE ARE

We are a stealth-stage healthcare AI startup that is the missing link in healthcare revenue management, bridging the gap between clinical care and financial operations. We're transforming how primary care clinics capture revenue through innovative AI technology that operates at the intersection of medical documentation, billing, and value-based care compliance.

In an industry where medical providers leave approximately 16% of their revenue uncollected due to insurance denials and compliance gaps, our mission is clear: enable healthcare providers to capture every dollar they've earned while uncovering new revenue opportunities.

Founded by experienced entrepreneurs with successful exits in healthcare technology and backed by advisors from leading health insurance companies, we are building a virtuous cycle that improves both patient care and provider profitability. We've already secured our first client contract and are positioned for a major pilot.

Our technology tackles critical challenges facing healthcare providers:

  • Real-time AI guidance for physicians at point-of-care
  • Automated coding and billing optimization
  • Intelligent claim follow‑up to reduce denials
  • Seamless compliance with value-based care requirements

Join us as we build technology that enables healthcare providers to thrive in an era of value-based care, maximizing revenues in primary care at scale.

WHY THIS ROLE IS PERFECT FOR YOU

This is your opportunity to shape production LLM applications that directly impact healthcare revenue and patient care. You'll work on a recently deployed AI system that automates medical coding and billing, evolving it from good to exceptional through meticulous refinement, rigorous testing, and continuous improvement.

You're not just implementing AI solutions—you're building a system that must get medical coding right the first time, understand complex insurance rules that change constantly, learn from denials, and continuously improve. Every line of code you write directly affects whether healthcare providers get paid and patients receive proper care.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Very hands‑on—we're looking for a builder who obsesses over details!

1. Build and Refine AI Products
  • Develop and implement new business rules for medical consultation billing codes, adapting to changes from various insurance providers
  • Propose and implement enhancements to our existing LLM-based products and optimize prompt engineering for maximum accuracy
  • Use AI‑assisted coding tools like Cursor as part of your daily workflow to rapidly build and iterate on solutions
2. Ensure Quality and Accuracy
  • Conduct extensive testing in staging environments and perform detailed debugging to ensure business rules are accurately implemented—in healthcare, "mostly right" isn't good enough
  • Verify data consistency from input to output to guarantee the solidity of our AI products
  • Monitor denial patterns and implement feedback loops that continuously improve model accuracy
3. Own the Development Lifecycle
  • Be responsible for the entire process from understanding business rules to deploying and validating code in production
  • Debug complex system integrations and validate AI outputs against medical coding standards
4. Collaborate and Drive Improvement
  • Work closely with AI, Tech, and Data Engineering teams to maintain complete understanding of the end-to-end process
  • Proactively identify critical issues, propose improvements, and stay current with new tools and techniques in the AI and LLM space
  • In the near future, contribute to fine‑tuning specialized LLM models with our internal knowledge base
REQUIRED EXPERTISE1. Technical Skills
  • Strong proficiency in programming languages like Python or Go
  • Hands‑on experience building products on top of large language models (LLMs)
  • Experience with LLM APIs (AWS Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or similar)
  • Strong prompt engineering skills with focus on accuracy and consistency
  • Solid understanding of how LLMs work and how to leverage them for production applications
  • Comfortable working with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and databases (PostgreSQL)
2. Mindset & Approach
  • Meticulous attention to detail with a strong capacity for debugging and code validation
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast‑paced, ever‑changing startup environment
  • Proven ability to learn new tools, frameworks, and business rules quickly
  • A self‑starter who can work independently but also collaborate effectively within a small team
  • Possesses a "big picture" perspective, understanding how your work fits into the entire end-to-end process from client data entry to insurance billing
3. Highly Valued Qualifications
  • Experience with AI‑assisted coding tools like Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar
  • Experience working in a startup or similar environment with constant change
  • Familiarity with RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) architectures
  • Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar)
  • Previous experience in healthcare technology, particularly with medical coding, billing, or revenue cycle management
  • Healthcare Domain Knowledge: Not required, but you must be willing and able to learn medical coding, billing rules, and insurance requirements quickly. We'll teach you what you need to know.

title: Analista Sênior De Auditoria Interna
description:
Trabalhar na Kavak é...Fazer parte de um time global que incentiva inovação e criatividade, em um ambiente onde a multidisciplinaridade se destaca. Aqui, diferentes perspectivas se unem para desenvolver soluções que revolucionam o mercado automotivo e a experiência do cliente. Cada ideia é valorizada e todos têm a chance de transformar o futuro. Se você busca projetos desafiadores e disruptivos, a KAVAK é o seu lugar.Missão dessa posição :As principais responsabilidades de um Auditor Interno envolvem apoiar os esforços de conformidade da Kavak com a Lei Sarbanes-Oxley ("SOX"), realizando testes e atividades de documentação relacionadas ao controle interno sobre relatórios financeiros ("ICFR"). O papel do Auditor Interno inclui a execução de testes e documentação de SOX/ICFR, identificação de deficiências de controle e interação com stakeholders no Brasil, Chile e Argentina para garantir consistência na aplicação dos controles internos.Descrição de Atividades :- Avaliar o desenho dos diferentes controles que abordam os riscos dos processos;
- Interagir com stakeholders locais, regionais e globais (Finanças, Operações, Compliance) para coordenar e facilitar as atividades de teste;
- Executar os testes deeficácia dos controles-chave dos procedimentos atribuídos;
- Apoiar na preparação dos artefatos de SOX, garantindo conformidade com políticas e regulamentações;
- Monitorar deficiênciasidentificadas, preparar observações preliminares e apoiar o acompanhamento das ações corretivas junto aos responsáveis pelos processos;
- Identificar lacunas oudeficiências de controle, incluindo a recomendação de melhorias de processo para proteger os ativos;
- Apoiar a elaboração eemissão do Relatório de Auditoria Interna, discutindo as deficiências com as áreas para acordar planos de ação e prazos de correção;
- Fornecer suporte regional para garantir metodologia e execução consistentes entre Brasil, Chile e Argentina;
- Apoiar a integração deCompliance, conectando achados de auditoria com processos regulatórios e de conformidade, quando aplicável;
- Documentar narrativasde processos, fluxogramas, descrições de controle e matrizes de riscos e controles (RCM) em conformidade com a SOX 404.- Compreender e documentar narrativas de processos e descrições de controle conforme os requisitos da SOX, a fim de identificar, avaliar e registrar riscos para as operações e ativos da organização, incluindo as Matrizes de Risco e Controle ("RCM").- Avaliar o desenho e a efetividade operacional dos controles e processos existentes.- Realizar walkthroughs (acompanhamentos de ponta a ponta dos processos), avaliando o desenho dos diferentes controles, acompanhando uma transação ao longo do processo, e identificando os controles-chave a serem testados quanto à sua eficácia operacional.- Executar procedimentos de teste, incluindo extração de dados, seleção de amostras, solicitação de evidências, realização de análises e documentação dos resultados dos testes.- Documentar deficiências de controle e preparar observações preliminares para inclusão nos relatórios.- Monitorar a implementação dos controles e das ações corretivas.- Identificar oportunidades de melhoria e automação de processos para aumentar a eficiência e a eficácia das operações.- Fornecer orientações e recomendações aos responsáveis pelos controles para fortalecer o ambiente de controle interno.Requisitos para candidatura :- Experiência em auditoria interna, controles internos ou consultoria de riscos, com foco em testes de SOX/ICFR;
- Sólido conhecimento emgestão de riscos, controles internos, SOX e outras regulamentações relevantes (por exemplo, Prevenção à Lavagem de Dinheiro e Financiamento do Terrorismo – "AML-CTF", Proteção de Dados, Instituições Financeiras, IFPE, SOFIPO, etc.);
- Experiência em testesde controle, avaliação de processos e gestão de planos de ação corretiva;
- Proficiência em análise de dados e sistemas relevantes, como ACL, IDEA, Tableau e similares;
- Bilíngue – proficiência profissional em inglês e espanhol;
- Excelentes habilidadesde comunicação;
- Capacidade de interagir de forma eficaz com stakeholders locais, regionais e globais, comunicando resultados de forma clara e profissional;
- Capacidade de trabalhar de forma independente e colaborativa em projetos complexos;
- Certificações específicas em auditoria interna são um diferencial (por exemplo, CIA, CRMA, entre outras).Habilidades que buscamos :- Bom comunicação- Pensamento crítico e orientação para melhoria contínua- Autonomia e colaboração em projetos complexos- Colaboração e espírito de equipe- Adaptabilidade e abertura para o novo- ProatividadeO que a Kavak te proporciona:- Assistência Médica e Odontológica para você e seus dependentes- WellHub (GymPass) :Nossa plataforma de bem-estar, que proporciona atividades físicas e cuidados com a saúde mental.- Vale-Refeição e/ou Alimentação: Crédito depositado no Cartão Flash, para você escolher onde e como utilizar.- Auxílio Mobilidade ou Vale Transporte : Flexibilidade para que você escolha o benefício que melhor se adapta ao seu dia a dia.- Estacionamento Gratuito no Local: Para quem prefere vir de carro, oferecemos estacionamento sem custo.- Transporte Fretado (sem desconto): Transporte fretado à disposição, proporcionando mais conforto e segurança no trajeto.- Seguro de Vida: Segurança adicional para você e sua família.- Day Off de Aniversário: Celebre seu dia com uma folga exclusiva.- Programa de Bônus Kavak: Recompensas com base em metas e performance, valorizando o seu esforço e dedicação.- Desconto para compra de carros : você pode escolher o carro seminovo ou usado dos seus sonhos, dentro do inventário da Kavak, com desconto exclusivo para Kavakes e ainda contar com 4 revisões a um valor simbólico, de acordo com nossa política vigente.Modelo de trabalho e local :- Modelo Híbrido: 3 dias presencial (mínimo) e 2 home office, podendo ser alterado futuramente conforme demanda e necessidades estratégicas.- Local de Trabalho: Kavak City - Barueri - SP.Sobre a KavakA Kavak iniciou a revolução no mercado automotivo em 2016, criando uma plataforma baseada no uso de dados e tecnologia que compra, recondiciona e vende carros usados pela internet ou nas dependências da empresa (hubs), com todas as garantias de segurança e confiabilidade, além das melhores opções de financiamento. Após quatro anos de operação, a Kavak se tornou a primeira empresa unicórnio da história do México e uma das startups mais valiosas da América Latina.

Aqui, diferentes perspectivas se unem para desenvolver soluções que revolucionam o mercado automotivo e a experiência do cliente. Cada ideia é valorizada e todos têm a chance de transformar o futuro. Se você busca projetos desafiadores e disruptivos, a KAVAK é o seu lugar.Missão dessa posição :As principais responsabilidades de um Auditor Interno envolvem apoiar os esforços de conformidade da Kavak com a Lei Sarbanes-Oxley ("SOX"), realizando testes e atividades de documentação relacionadas ao controle interno sobre relatórios financeiros ("ICFR"). O papel do Auditor Interno inclui a execução de testes e documentação de SOX/ICFR, identificação de deficiências de controle e interação com stakeholders no Brasil, Chile e Argentina para garantir consistência na aplicação dos controles internos.Descrição de Atividades :- Avaliar o desenho dos diferentes controles que abordam os riscos dos processos;
- Interagir com stakeholders locais, regionais e globais (Finanças, Operações, Compliance) para coordenar e facilitar as atividades de teste;
- Executar os testes deeficácia dos controles-chave dos procedimentos atribuídos;
- Apoiar na preparação dos artefatos de SOX, garantindo conformidade com políticas e regulamentações;
- Monitorar deficiênciasidentificadas, preparar observações preliminares e apoiar o acompanhamento das ações corretivas junto aos responsáveis pelos processos;
- Identificar lacunas oudeficiências de controle, incluindo a recomendação de melhorias de processo para proteger os ativos;
- Apoiar a elaboração eemissão do Relatório de Auditoria Interna, discutindo as deficiências com as áreas para acordar planos de ação e prazos de correção;
- Fornecer suporte regional para garantir metodologia e execução consistentes entre Brasil, Chile e Argentina;
- Apoiar a integração deCompliance, conectando achados de auditoria com processos regulatórios e de conformidade, quando aplicável;
- Documentar narrativasde processos, fluxogramas, descrições de controle e matrizes de riscos e controles (RCM) em conformidade com a SOX 404.- Compreender e documentar narrativas de processos e descrições de controle conforme os requisitos da SOX, a fim de identificar, avaliar e registrar riscos para as operações e ativos da organização, incluindo as Matrizes de Risco e Controle ("RCM").- Avaliar o desenho e a efetividade operacional dos controles e processos existentes.- Realizar walkthroughs (acompanhamentos de ponta a ponta dos processos), avaliando o desenho dos diferentes controles, acompanhando uma transação ao longo do processo, e identificando os controles-chave a serem testados quanto à sua eficácia operacional.- Executar procedimentos de teste, incluindo extração de dados, seleção de amostras, solicitação de evidências, realização de análises e documentação dos resultados dos testes.- Documentar deficiências de controle e preparar observações preliminares para inclusão nos relatórios.- Monitorar a implementação dos controles e das ações corretivas.- Identificar oportunidades de melhoria e automação de processos para aumentar a eficiência e a eficácia das operações.- Fornecer orientações e recomendações aos responsáveis pelos controles para fortalecer o ambiente de controle interno.Requisitos para candidatura :- Experiência em auditoria interna, controles internos ou consultoria de riscos, com foco em testes de SOX/ICFR;
- Sólido conhecimento emgestão de riscos, controles internos, SOX e outras regulamentações relevantes (por exemplo, Prevenção à Lavagem de Dinheiro e Financiamento do Terrorismo – "AML-CTF", Proteção de Dados, Instituições Financeiras, IFPE, SOFIPO, etc.);
- Experiência em testesde controle, avaliação de processos e gestão de planos de ação corretiva;
- Proficiência em análise de dados e sistemas relevantes, como ACL, IDEA, Tableau e similares;
- Bilíngue – proficiência profissional em inglês e espanhol;
- Excelentes habilidadesde comunicação;
- Capacidade de interagir de forma eficaz com stakeholders locais, regionais e globais, comunicando resultados de forma clara e profissional;
- Capacidade de trabalhar de forma independente e colaborativa em projetos complexos;
- Certificações específicas em auditoria interna são um diferencial (por exemplo, CIA, CRMA, entre outras).Habilidades que buscamos :- Bom comunicação- Pensamento crítico e orientação para melhoria contínua- Autonomia e colaboração em projetos complexos- Colaboração e espírito de equipe- Adaptabilidade e abertura para o novo- ProatividadeO que a Kavak te proporciona:- Assistência Médica e Odontológica para você e seus dependentes- WellHub (GymPass) :Nossa plataforma de bem-estar, que proporciona atividades físicas e cuidados com a saúde mental.- Vale-Refeição e/ou Alimentação: Crédito depositado no Cartão Flash, para você escolher onde e como utilizar.- Auxílio Mobilidade ou Vale Transporte : Flexibilidade para que você escolha o benefício que melhor se adapta ao seu dia a dia.- Estacionamento Gratuito no Local: Para quem prefere vir de carro, oferecemos estacionamento sem custo.- Transporte Fretado (sem desconto): Transporte fretado à disposição, proporcionando mais conforto e segurança no trajeto.- Seguro de Vida: Segurança adicional para você e sua família.- Day Off de Aniversário: Celebre seu dia com uma folga exclusiva.- Programa de Bônus Kavak: Recompensas com base em metas e performance, valorizando o seu esforço e dedicação.- Desconto para compra de carros : você pode escolher o carro seminovo ou usado dos seus sonhos, dentro do inventário da Kavak, com desconto exclusivo para Kavakes e ainda contar com 4 revisões a um valor simbólico, de acordo com nossa política vigente.Modelo de trabalho e local :- Modelo Híbrido: 3 dias presencial (mínimo) e 2 home office, podendo ser alterado futuramente conforme demanda e necessidades estratégicas.- Local de Trabalho: Kavak City - Barueri - SP.Sobre a KavakA Kavak iniciou a revolução no mercado automotivo em 2016, criando uma plataforma baseada no uso de dados e tecnologia que compra, recondiciona e vende carros usados pela internet ou nas dependências da empresa (hubs), com todas as garantias de segurança e confiabilidade, além das melhores opções de financiamento. Após quatro anos de operação, a Kavak se tornou a primeira empresa unicórnio da história do México e uma das startups mais valiosas da América Latina.

title: Senior User Experience Designer - Sap Concur Travel
description:
Senior User Experience Designer - SAP Concur Travel

We help the world run better At SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we'll bring out the best in you. We're builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what's next. The work is challenging – but it matters. You'll find a place where you can be yourself, prioritize your wellbeing, and truly belong. What's in it for you? Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed.

As the world’s leading provider of integrated travel and expense management solutions, SAP Concur is driven by a relentless pursuit to simplify and automate these everyday processes. At the heart of this is our commitment to the User Experience and we see the impact research, design and data has on improving experiences every day.

As our commitment to UX grows we are looking for a Senior UX Designer in the Travel UX team. You will be responsible for your work and accompany your concepts throughout the development life cycle, and you are continuously broadening your horizon on design methods and technologies. You work in partnership with our extended global product teams to develop simple and intuitive user experiences for our customers and millions of users around the world.

Who are you
  • A natural collaborator and communicator: you are able to develop and present design ideas in a large team environment.
  • Prior experience working within a technical environment is a key requirement.
  • You possess strong experience and interaction design skills, as well as comprehensive knowledge of user-centered design principles.
  • You have an affinity for consistency and a keen eye for subtle details.
  • You are able to grasp and distill complex issues and translate them into clean, focused, understandable solutions.
  • You’ll work closely with Design Systems and Accessibility teams to ensure consistent and accessible design solutions.
  • You should be a self-starter, self-motivated, able to work independently, and perform multiple tasks under minimal supervision.
Work Experience and Qualifications
  • Solid corporate work experience with a focus on software design across a variety of platforms.
  • A great eye for detail, demonstrated creative and innovative problem-solving skills.
  • Experience designing UI products from conception to completion from the discovery through to the development process.
  • Ability to clearly communicate concepts and designs through sketches, wireframes, high fidelity comps, and prototypes.
  • Able to function both independently and in a team environment with solid collaboration skills.
  • Enthusiasm and history working in an iterative design process, motivated by group critique.
  • Excellent communication skills with ability to articulate design work to large groups and stakeholders.
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Human Computer Interaction, Graphic Design, Media Arts or other relevant experience.
  • Experience designing and prototyping in Figma.
  • Experience in mobile app and component design.
  • Experience in designing for accessibility.
  • You have a portfolio that displays a spectrum of creative design solutions.
Bring out your best

SAP innovations help more than four hundred thousand customers worldwide work together more efficiently and use business insight more effectively. Originally known for leadership in enterprise resource planning (ERP) software, SAP has evolved to become a market leader in end-to-end business application software and related services for database, analytics, intelligent technologies, and experience management. As a cloud company with two hundred million users and more than one hundred thousand employees worldwide, we are purpose-driven and future-focused, with a highly collaborative team ethic and commitment to personal development. Whether connecting global industries, people, or platforms, we help ensure every challenge gets the solution it deserves. At SAP, you can bring out your best.

We win with inclusion

SAP’s culture of inclusion, focus on health and well-being, and flexible working models help ensure that everyone – regardless of background – feels included and can run at their best. At SAP, we believe we are made stronger by the unique capabilities and qualities that each person brings to our company, and we invest in our employees to inspire confidence and help everyone realize their full potential. We ultimately believe in unleashing all talent and creating a better world.

Legal and Accessibility

SAP is committed to the values of Equal Employment Opportunity and provides accessibility accommodations to applicants with physical and/or mental disabilities. If you are interested in applying for employment with SAP and are in need of accommodation or special assistance to navigate our website or to complete your application, please send an e-mail with your request to Recruiting Operations Team:

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their age, race, religion, national origin, ethnicity, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, et al), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, or disability, in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local legal requirements.

Successful candidates might be required to undergo a background verification with an external vendor.

Please note that any violation of these guidelines may result in disqualification from the hiring process.
