  • Desenvolver e gerenciar a estratégia robusta de mídia paga (Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Meta Ads), utilizando recursos de IA e automação das plataformas para otimização de lances, criativos e segmentação
  • Liderar o uso estratégico do RD Station (CRM e Automação de Marketing) para lead nurturing e comunicação, explorando funcionalidades (chatbots, sugestão de conteúdo e lead scoring) para aumentar a conversão e a retenção B2B
  • Garantir a busca e a implementação contínua de novas ferramentas e metodologias que incorporem Inteligência Artificial (ou quaisquer novas ferramentas) para gerar eficiência no Marketing
  • Gestão de Conteúdo e Alcance
  • Garantir a parceria e o alinhamento contínuo com o time de Conteúdo para otimizar as campanhas de Paid Media e o funil de conversão
  • Definir e executar estratégias para aumentar o alcance e o engajamento do Grupo Moas nas redes sociais e demais canais digitais, fortalecendo o reconhecimento de marca
  • Gestão e Alinhamento Operacional
  • Gerenciar fornecedores e parceiros estratégicos
  • Garantir a execução e o acompanhamento de projetos e campanhas utilizando o Click Up (ferramenta de gestão de projetos)
  • Promover a integração e o alinhamento entre Marketing, Comercial e demais stakeholders
Competências Comportamentais (Soft Skills):
  • Habilidade para se comunicar de forma clara e objetiva, essencial para apresentar resultados complexos à Diretoria e pares e promover um ótimo relacionamento interpessoal
  • Capacidade de ir além dos números, identificando tendências e transformando dados em estratégias de crescimento de longo prazo
  • Disposição e iniciativa para testar e implementar novas tecnologias (IA, novas ferramentas, etc), visando a otimização contínua
  • Forte mentalidade colaborativa para trabalhar em conjunto com o time de Conteúdo, Produto, Vendas, ou outros
  • Focado(a) no impacto do Marketing para as metas de aquisição e retenção do negócio
Requisitos e Habilidades Técnicas (Hard Skills):
  • Superior completo em Publicidade, Marketing, Comunicação Social, Administração ou áreas correlatas
  • Data Analytics Avançado
  • Proficiência em Google Analytics 4 (GA4)
  • Configuração, relatórios e análise de funis B2B
  • Criação e Apresentação de Dashboards de performance (Ex: Power BI, Looker Studio ou ferramentas similares)
  • Conhecimento avançado e prático em construção, gestão e otimização de campanhas para B2B em Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads e Meta Ads
  • Conhecimento no uso e gestão do RD Station (CRM e Automação de Marketing) ou similares
  • Familiaridade e interesse genuíno em incorporar ferramentas e métodos de Inteligência Artificial na rotina de Marketing e análise de dados
  • Vivência na gestão de fluxos de trabalho e acompanhamento de tarefas via ClickUp ou similares
  • Conhecimento em Account Based Marketing (ABM)
  • Vivência com otimização de landing pages e CRO (Conversion Rate Optimization)
  • Conhecimento em SEO (Search Engine Optimization)
  • Vivência ou conhecimento em estratégia, implementação ou gestão de plataformas de E-commerce (Ex: Vtex, Shopify, Nuvemshop ou outras)
Criando conexões com propósito: esse é o Nosso Jeito

No Grupo Moas, acreditamos no poder das conexões. Somos um time apaixonado por qualidade, movido por inovação e guiado por valores sólidos como cuidado, transparência, respeito e colaboração. Desde 2003, crescemos com o olhar atento de quem entende que bem-estar se constrói com sensibilidade e funcionalidade.

Na jornada das famílias, desenvolvemos produtos de puericultura, cuidados com a pele e momentos especiais com os pequenos — sempre com segurança, afeto e responsabilidade.

Já no universo da casa, inspiramos pessoas a criarem ambientes com alma, unindo curadoria, design contemporâneo e acessibilidade.

Conecte-se ao nosso propósito

Hoje, as marcas do Grupo Moas somam mais de 1 milhão de seguidores nas redes sociais e encantam e impactam mais de 10 milhões de pessoas todos os meses. Um alcance que reflete a força da nossa essência: criar conexões reais entre pessoas, lares e histórias.

Se você compartilha dessa essência e quer crescer junto com um grupo que valoriza o desenvolvimento, o bem-estar e a criatividade coletiva, o Grupo Moas é o seu lugar.

Job description

Somos o Sicredi, a primeira instituição financeira cooperativa do Brasil. Nosso modelo de negócio constrói uma cadeia de valor que beneficia o associado, a cooperativa e a comunidade local. Oferecemos mais de 300 produtos e serviços financeiros de um jeito simples e próximo para você, para a sua empresa e para o seu agronegócio. Mas o que nos faz diferentes é que ao se associar, você adquire uma pequena cota da sua cooperativa, passando a ser dono do Sicredi, tendo voz sobre as decisões do negócio e participando dos resultados. É por isso que o Sicredi é seu, meu e nosso. Aqui todos têm a oportunidade de decidir e participar, assim criamos laços de confiança que nos permitem crescer. Juntos.

Main responsibilities

Gestão de Pessoas: Exercer a liderança da equipe.

Prestar consultoria financeira aos associados e demais públicos de interesse, nas dependências da agência e em visitas externas.

Gestão das operações e serviços: Responder pela movimentação financeira da agência, conforme normas e procedimentos institucionalizados.

Planejamento: Liderar, elaborar e executar o planejamento da agência, focando o curto, médio e longo prazo.

Projetar e realizar o encaminhamento das ações necessárias à manutenção e ampliação de associados, a fim de fomentar sua principalidade no Sicredi. Otimizar resultados no que se refere a custos e rentabilidade, de acordo com o planejado.

Relacionamento com o quadro social: Fomentar o relacionamento com o quadro social e organizar os eventos.

Gestão do Risco: Gerir os riscos inerentes as operações da agência, tendo visão global do grau de cada risco, visando a segurança em todos os processos.

Organizar e responder pela gestão dos Programas de Relacionamento em sua agência, incentivando a participação dos associados, visando o das comunidades e dos negócios.

Representante Legal da agência: Atuar como procurador da Cooperativa, representando em todas as esferas necessárias para o atendimento das questões legai e de negócios.

Gestão de carteira de Associados: Responder pela administração e desenvolvimento de carteira de associados.

Ouvidoria: Realizar a gestão das demandas de ouvidoria junto à equipe visando solucionar os apontamentos e assegurar a resolução de demandas dos associados.

Requirements and skills

Nível de formação Ensino Superior (concluído) Área de formação: Administração de Empresas, Ciências Contábeis, Economia, Áreas afins.

Certificações e Registros necessários CPA 20.

Habilidades e Temas de conhecimento desejáveis: Produtos e serviços financeiros, Sistema Financeiro Nacional, Matemática financeira, Negociação, Gestão de Pessoas, Visão de negócio financeiro.

Disponibilidade para residir em Santa Rita do Passa Quatro/SP.

Additional information

title: Growth Marketer In Global Running Company – Part-Time With Room To Grow Into Head Of Marketing
description:
Growth Marketer – Part‑Time, Global Running Company

Hi... My name is Lena, and I am the founder of Go! Running Tours. This is not your usual job post. Instead of writing a fast‑paced, bullet‑pointed post with words like driven, team player, high performer, etc., I thought I would give it a go at simply writing the good, the bad, and the ugly about being a Growth Marketer with Go! Running Tours.

I just need one really good one! So let's start. Our new Growth Marketer will be responsible for all our marketing activities for B2C and B2B clients. Our current markets are growing (some by 100+%) and we are constantly looking for new channels and markets to sell our services. Your marketing DNA has to be of the rare kind that is analytical and structured, while also having the creativity to craft great copy, see new opportunities, and connect the dots between B2C and B2B.

I am looking for a colleague who works systematically with new ideas and markets, has attention to detail, and gets super excited about the responsibility you are given and the fact that the world is your marketing playground. We are lucky that sometimes amazing opportunities (that if you are a runner and marketeer – probably will make you do cartwheels) land in our turban.

You’ll be working on a newsletter and more.

  • An email lands in your inbox from an industry leader, and you craft a response that drives engagement.
  • Email marketing is a strong channel for us;
    if you get a thrill from optimising flows, building smart automations, and digging into data to make things work better and smarter, then this is your playground.
  • We already send regular newsletters that do well, but someone with a data/automation mindset who puts their Sherlock Holmes hat on will, without a doubt, be able to optimise this tremendously.
  • You will be planning and running digital advertising campaigns on Meta and Google, exploring new platforms, and keeping an eye on what actually moves the needle.
  • You will also create clever case studies, explore sponsorship opportunities, and pitch bold ideas that help us reach new runners, new companies, and new destinations.
  • If you spot a gap, we want you to fill it (and we’ll back you while you do).

You will be working directly with me in the role. I love my job, and every day I am utterly grateful that I work in a company with a concept that "makes sense" to me, and with colleagues who are skilled, helpful, and positive. I love running, and I have the pleasure of working with runners from all over the world and together, we cater for the best customer group in the world: runners.

We work remotely and have only 2–3 hours of internal meetings a week. All other time is reserved for deep work and basically getting things done. There is always time for a call, and we are all on Slack, so you’re never left alone in any way.

The salary is not one that will secure you a Ferrari or a holiday to Mauritius (at least not to begin with). It is a salary that should be comfortable and is based on reduced working hours, so you can have a fun and fulfilling life besides work. The Money Should Not Be The Main Motivation For You – Running, Bridging Cultures, And Being Part Of a Fun, Fast‑moving, And Positive Company Should. The Contract Details Are As Follows:

  • USD 1,400 a month
  • 25 hrs a week
  • Managed via Upwork

Oh, and hey… if you’re considering this role as an add‑on to an already existing full‑time job, then hold your horses. I don't believe in my colleagues working 60+ hours a week, and it simply doesn't align with our company values. We want you to have the energy, focus, and headspace to do great work and enjoy life outside of it. The most important traits to bring to the role are being a fast mover, a super collaborator, and having a drive to grow… the business and yourself. But the most important skill of all is execution. If we don't execute, we can't move the needle.

I've probably left out loads of super important things, but at least this gives you some idea. If you feel this role could be for you, then please write to me with a short spiel on why you feel you're right for the role and why you would like to work at Go! Running Tours (no AI please – we want to know the real you, not the ChatGPT version ). Thanks for reading this far, Lena.

Note: we usually take down our job posts within 3-4 days as we receive many applicants.

Entry level

title: Medical Science Liaison
description:
Medical Science Liaison

Location: Rio de Janeiro / Belo Horizonte

Field-based work model

At Sanofi, we are driven by one purpose – we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives. Our team, across some 100 countries, is dedicated to transforming the practice of medicine by working to turn the impossible into the possible.

We never settle and now we are creating a new paradigm with a first-in-class therapy in Autoimmune Diabetes (Type 1 Diabetes).

Our newest core asset, resulting from the acquisition of Prevention Bio in General Medicines Autoimmune Type 1 Diabetes space, aims at delaying the onset of stage 3 type 1 diabetes. This means that for the first time, people at risk of developing this lifelong disease have fresh hope. What delayed onset means is more time for children to be children with less healthcare and more care-free childhood. The delay also gives families and healthcare professionals more time to prepare care plans for a later diagnosis.

Job Description

We are seeking a highly motivated and visionary scientific leader to serve as a MSL with expertise in T1D. This role combines deep scientific expertise with strategic thinking to enhance the identification and management of people at risk of developing T1D, emphasizing the benefits of early detection and the use of new immunomodulators.

As a MSL - Autoimmune T1D Specialist, you will be the trusted scientific partner for external experts and decision-makers, while also contributing to the development and implementation of screening and monitoring strategies as well as engaging with experts in new therapies such as immunomodulators. This dual focus position will drive both scientific exchange and strategic initiatives to improve early identification and management of T1D.

Main responsibilitiesScientific Leadership & KOL Engagement
  • Serve as trusted scientific partner to key external experts (including KOLs, endocrinologists, pediatricians, and other scientific stakeholders), establishing and maintaining robust, long-term peer relationships
  • Conduct high-touch scientific exchange with experts from Centers of Excellence and beyond to convey a compelling and highly scientific narrative on T1D disease stages, importance of screening and treatment
  • Engage with experts to share scientific data, answer product-specific questions, and support them in developing best practices (e.G., infusion protocols)
  • Link internal partners to external thought leaders for education and research collaboration
  • Disseminate innovative medical education materials and foster medical/scientific information exchange within the medical community
  • Tailor engagement to different stakeholder segments based on comprehensive stakeholder mapping and local go-to-market model
  • Work with cross-functional teams to leverage an omnichannel approach, orchestrating high-touch and personalized engagement across innovative channels (e.G., social media, peer-to-peer communities, online portals)
Early Detection Strategy
  • Collaborate with medical teams to develop and implement evidence-based screening and monitoring protocols
  • Provide scientific expertise in the development of risk-identification strategies
  • Support the adaptation of global screening and monitoring strategies to local contexts
  • Contribute to the scientific validation of new testing methodologies and channels
  • Engage with experts to promote best practices in screening and early intervention
  • Promote experience sharing among key external experts to reinforce consensus on screening and treatment protocols at local level
Strategic Implementation
  • Partner with cross-functional teams in agile settings with self-organized teams around main customer accounts to improve patient pathways and remove barriers
  • Provide scientific input on screening partnerships and initiatives
  • Gather and analyze field insights to inform medical strategy and screening programs
  • Support Market Access teams in evidence-based discussions with regional payers, drug formulary committees, and key account decision-makers on clinical value and health economics
  • Coordinate and direct requests for ISS, RCT, Managed Access Programs to appropriate teams
  • Keep up-to-date on medical and scientific developments in the Type 1 Diabetes field
Individual Contributors
  • Maintain knowledge of and comply with the principles of Ethics and Integrity, Sanofi policies, and codes of conduct that regulate the pharmaceutical market.
  • Comply with and promote Sanofi's Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) policies, with the objective of preventing accidents, avoiding health risks, promoting employee well-being, and reducing environmental impacts resulting from work activities.
  • Support Sanofi's Diversity and Inclusion strategy and initiatives to ensure that all employees and partners are treated with respect and receive equal opportunities.
About youExperience
  • Minimum 3 years experience as MSL in Specialty / Rare disease / Type 1 Diabetes area
  • Experience in T1D or immunology highly preferred
  • Background in clinical research or academic setting
  • Experience with population health initiatives or screening programs is a plus
Soft skills
  • Strategic thinking.
  • Business acumen.
  • Interpersonal relationship.
  • Transversal collaboration.
  • Learning agility.
  • Ability to build proper environment to enable Playing to Win culture to flourish.
Professional competencies
  • Strong analytical capabilities for data interpretation and insights generation
  • Excellence in scientific communication and presentation
  • Strategic thinking and ability to translate science into actionable insights
  • Strong collaboration skills for cross-functional teamwork
  • Ability to build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders
  • Project management capabilities
Technical skills
  • Advanced understanding of T1D clinical science and current research
  • Expertise in interpreting and communicating complex scientific data
  • Knowledge of screening methodologies and monitoring protocols
  • Understanding of healthcare systems and population health approaches
Education
  • Advanced degree required (MD, PharmD, PhD) in relevant scientific or medical field
  • Additional training in public health or population health management preferred
Language

Advanced English required.

Why should you choose us?
  • Be part of a purpose-driven organization that pursues the miracles of science to improve people’s lives worldwide
  • Access comprehensive benefits including health insurance, life insurance, and pension plans aligned with market best practices
  • Enjoy flexible work arrangements that support work-life integration and well-being
  • Benefit from continuous learning and development opportunities through Sanofi University and specialized training programs
  • Be part of building a new concept in autoimmune Type 1 Diabetes by bringing early detection and the use of new immunomodulators capable of changing the course of the disease.
  • Join Brazil’s largest and fastest-growing immunology franchise, playing a key role in the growth strategy and market leadership

Progress wouldn’t be possible without people;
people from different backgrounds, in different locations, performing different roles, but all united by a common goal: the desire to make miracles happen. You can become one of these people. Seek change, embrace new ideas, and explore all the opportunities we have to offer. Pursue progress and discover the extraordinary with us.

At Sanofi, we provide equal opportunities to all, regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, nationality, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or gender identity.

title: Growth Marketer In Global Running Company - Part-Time With Room To Grow Into Head Of Marketing
description:
Growth Marketer – Part-Time (Grow into Head of Marketing)

Hi... My name is Lena, and I am the founder of Go! Running Tours. This is not your usual job post. Instead of writing a fast‑paced, bullet‑pointed post with the words driven, team player, high performer, etc., I thought I would give it a go at simply writing the good, the bad, and the ugly about being a Growth Marketer with Go! Running Tours.

Our new Growth Marketer will be responsible for all our marketing activities for B2C and B2B clients. Our current markets are growing (some by 100+%) and we are constantly looking for new channels and markets to sell our services.

Your marketing DNA has to be of the rare kind that is analytical and structured, while also having the creativity to craft great copy, see new opportunities, and connect the dots between B2C and B2B. I am looking for a colleague who works systematically with new ideas and markets, has attention to detail, and gets super excited about the responsibility you are given and the fact that the world is your marketing playground.

We are lucky that sometimes amazing opportunities (that - if you are a runner and marketeer - probably will make you do cartwheels) land in our turban. You'll be working on a newsletter, an email that lands in your inbox from Brooks, Lululemon or Abbott World Marathon Majors, and other times, results come from your structured and clever efforts over time. Not because we got it right the first time, but because we kept on researching, learning, testing and voilà – now you nailed it!

Our clients include US Bank, Goldman Sachs, Amex, Google, Accenture and runners of equal awesomeness from all over the world! We also work with some of the biggest names in the running industry (NDA signed) and in the future, with your help, many more…right?

I am looking for someone in constant growth mode. Growth in terms of always looking for new opportunities to grow the business. Growth in terms of testing an initiative in one city and then scaling it to the rest of our destinations. Growth in terms of taking the time to research new tech, new ways of doing things, and current trends.

Email marketing is a strong channel of ours, and if you get a thrill from optimising flows, building smart automations, and digging into data to make things work better and smarter, then this is your playground. We already send regular newsletters that do well, but someone with a data/automation mindset who puts their Sherlock Holmes hat on will, without a doubt, be able to optimise this tremendously.

You will also own our digital advertising efforts. That means planning and running campaigns on Meta and Google, exploring new platforms, and keeping an eye on what actually moves the needle. You’ll also get to create clever case studies, explore sponsorship opportunities, and pitch bold ideas that help us reach new runners, new companies, and new destinations. If you spot a gap, we want you to fill it (and we’ll back you while you do).

You will work directly with me. I love my job, and every day I am utterly grateful that I work in a company with a concept that "makes sense" to me, and with colleagues who are skilled, helpful, and positive. We work remotely and have only 2–3 hours of internal meetings a week. All other time is reserved for deep work and basically getting things done. There is always time for a call, and we are all on Slack, so you’re never left alone.

The salary is not one that will secure you a Ferrari or a holiday to Mauritius (at least not to begin with). It is a salary that should be comfortable and is based on reduced working hours, so you can have a fun and fulfilling life besides work. The money should not be the main motivation for you – running, bridging cultures, and being part of a fun, fast‑moving, and positive company should.

Contract Details
  • USD 1,400 a month
  • 25 hrs a week
  • Managed via Upwork

Oh, and hey… if you’re considering this role as an add‑on to an already existing full‑time job, then hold your horses. I don’t believe in my colleagues working 60+ hours a week, and it simply doesn’t align with our company values. We want you to have the energy, focus, and headspace to do great work and enjoy life outside of it.

The most important traits to bring to the role are being a fast mover, a super collaborator, and having a drive to grow… the business and yourself. But the most important skill of all is: execution. If we don’t execute, we can’t move the needle.

Thanks for reading this far,

Lena

title: Airport Services Officer
description: Fulkrum is a global leader in inspection, expediting, auditing, and technical staffing services, delivering exceptional solutions to the energy, engineering, and construction industries for over 14 years. Headquartered in the UK, we have established a strong presence across six continents, serving more than 300 clients worldwide. Our commitment to excellence has been recognised with prestigious awards, including the King's Award for Enterprise in International Trade (2023), the People and Competency Award at the EIC Awards (2023), and the Scale-Up Award at the WESCA North America Awards (2024). Most recently, Fulkrum was named the 2025 winner in the People, Culture & Optimisation category at the EIC North & Central America Regional Awards. Our Brazil Office is currently seeking a highly motivated and experienced Operations Manager to join our dynamic team. Main Responsibilities (include but are not limited to): Operational Leadership Efficiency and Compliance: Guide the team in operational excellence through regular training and adherence to work instructions, ensuring timely responses, accurate reporting, and proper use of the IRIS system, Integrated Management System, and all company policies, processes, and procedures. Overall responsibility for leadership and support, which enables the team and Region to meet and surpass KPIs and Quality Metrics. Training and Development: Conduct initial and ongoing training for QC Coordinators (QCCs), maintaining minimal errors and supporting development. Ensure the gap analysis assessment is completed for all new starters and, as needed, for experienced coordinators. IRIS Compliance: Oversee IRIS accuracy and compliance for the Region, ensuring client and inspector profiles, rates, assignments, and reports are up-to-date and meet Fulkrum standards. Operations Managers should become “super-users” of IRIS, driving continuous improvements throughout the team and the business. Financial Oversight: Improve cash flow and reduce the Cash Conversion Cycle (CCC) by supporting Accounts and managing invoicing challenges between departments, reducing errors and minimising un-invoiced visits, ensuring POs and approvals are received on time, supporting credit control escalations, and reporting issues promptly and consistently to Senior Management. Identify areas for improvement between coordination and accounts, suggest process improvements, draft Corrective Action Reports (CARs), and support cash flow and credit control objectives. Budget Management: Support the Regional Manager in budget maintenance, report on client activity levels, and drive financial efficiencies. Monitor and manage office expenses and personnel utilisation. Recommend improvements to the Regional Manager. Gross Profit Targets: Ensure gross profit objectives by overseeing client and inspector negotiations, minimising reliance on agencies, and upholding service standards. Growth and Client Engagement: Collaborate with Sales to highlight Fulkrum’s capabilities and successes, recommend growth opportunities, and support the acquisition of new clients and service lines. Present IRIS and Fulkrum’s strengths in client meetings to support business development. Client Retention: Schedule reviews with key clients, addressing service quality and identifying any gaps for improvement. Maintain client relationships through regular communication and promptly address any issues to ensure satisfaction. Report concerns to the Regional Manager as needed. CRM and Reporting: Document client interactions in Salesforce, compile monthly reports, and highlight successes, challenges, and key client insights for the Regional Manager. Overhead Management: Regularly assess team workloads to maintain operational efficiencies, minimise redundancies, and support overhead budget goals. Propose staffing adjustments to the Regional Manager as required. Team Development Recruitment and Onboarding: Collaborate with HR to recruit and onboard new team members, ensuring resources and support are ready for a smooth start. Performance and Probation Management: Lead 30-, 60-, and 90-day reviews for new hires, ensuring development aligns with company standards. Conduct regular performance evaluations and address skill gaps through targeted training. Compliance & QHSE Process Optimisation: Act as a “process expert” within Fulkrum, supporting the Integrated Management System (IMS) and continuous process improvements. Collaborate on IRIS developments and provide training for each improvement. Focal Point: for QHSE and Compliance during internal/external audits, draft and implement CARs as necessary, support all IMS initiatives for process improvements. Commercial Proposal and Contract Support: Support bid preparation, draft project-specific execution plans and procedures, create/approve rate sheets, perform contract renewals, and support all other commercial requirements as needed. Insurance and Compliance: Coordinate insurance documents,

description:

supporting clients in assessing their Human Capital Management strategy & demonstrating why ADP should be their chosen partner. To work alongside your fellow Leaders in identifying training & development needs across the wider team. Delivering training sessions (ad-hoc) To submit the relevant management reports in a timely manner including up to date forecasting information. Education and experience: Must be able to demonstrate extensive direct selling experience, preferably within a Payroll/HR software and service environment and consistent over performance Team Leader/Sales Management experience (desirable). description: Quem Somos A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants. Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade. O que esperar de nós Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade. Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento. O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho Criar e manter integrações entre sistemas (usando APIs REST). Desenvolver aplicações em .NET (C#). Trabalhar com nuvem Azure (funções, serviços, armazenamento, mensageria, monitoramento). Usar GitHub e pipelines CI/CD para versionamento e automação. Aplicar boas práticas de código (SOLID, Clean Code). Escrever testes automatizados e documentação técnica. Atuar de forma ágil (Scrum, SAFe). O que você precisa ter: Pelo menos 4 anos de experiência com .NET (C#). Experiência prática com metodologias ágeis. Certificação AZ-104 (Azure Administrator). Azure Functions Azure App Services Azure Key Vault Azure Storage Service Bus Application Insights Git/GitHub e CI/CD (GitHub Actions). Criação e consumo de APIs REST. Segurança com OAuth2 e JWT. Integrações entre diferentes plataformas. Testes automatizados (unitários e de integração). Aplicação de Design Patterns e SOLID. Escrita de código limpo e documentação técnica. Inglês Avançado/Fluente Onde você vai trabalhar?No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office

title: Advogado Aduaneiro
description:
Descrição da Função

Profissional responsável por atuar em demandas jurídicas relacionadas ao comércio exterior, operações aduaneiras e normas aplicáveis à importação e exportação. O advogado será responsável por assessorar clientes em procedimentos administrativos e judiciais, oferecendo suporte técnico e estratégico em matérias aduaneiras.

Responsabilidades
  • Elaborar análises e pareceres jurídicos sobre legislação aduaneira, tributária e de comércio exterior.
  • Atuar em processos administrativos perante a Receita Federal, SEFAZ, CARF e demais órgãos governamentais.
  • Conduzir defesas, recursos e impugnações em autos de infração, penalidades e exigências fiscais.
  • Acompanhar fiscalizações, processos de despacho aduaneiro e regimes especiais.
  • Assessorar empresas em compliance aduaneiro, classificação fiscal (NCM), valoração aduaneira e revisão de procedimentos.
  • Redigir contratos e orientar sobre riscos jurídicos em operações internacionais.
  • Realizar consultorias preventivas e estratégicas para redução de contingências fiscais.
  • Participar de reuniões com clientes, emitir relatórios e conduzir tratativas técnicas.
Requisitos
  • Formação superior completa em Direito.
  • OAB ativa.
  • Experiência comprovada em Direito Aduaneiro e Comércio Exterior.
  • Conhecimento sólido da legislação aduaneira, SISCOMEX, regimes especiais e normas da Receita Federal.
  • Desejável vivência com litígios administrativos (DRJ/CARF).
  • Habilidade em análise de classificação fiscal e valoração aduaneira.
  • Boa comunicação escrita e verbal, capacidade analítica e postura profissional.
  • Escolaridade Mínima: Pós-graduação - Doutorado
Salário e condições
  • Local de trabalho: Rio de Janeiro, RJ
  • Regime de contratação: Outros
  • Jornada: Período Integral
  • Área e especialização profissional: Comércio Exterior, Importação, Exportação - Relações Internacionais
  • Nível hierárquico: Especialista
Idiomas
  • Espanhol (Intermediário)
  • Inglês (Avançado)
Valorizado

Tempo de experiência: Mais de 10 anos

title: Analista De Contratos De Ti
description:
Descrição da Vaga
  • Vaga Temporária: 3 meses
  • Contrato no modelo: RPA
  • Híbrido: Rio de Janeiro - Centro (8x presenciais mensais)

Estamos procurando um(a) Analista de Contratos de TI altamente motivado(a) e experiente para se juntar à nossa equipe de tecnologia. O candidato ideal terá um histórico comprovado de sucesso de atuação em áreas de Governança, Prestadores de Serviço e Contratos de TI, bem como habilidades de comunicação e colaboração em equipe.

Responsabilidades

O profissional será responsável por apoiar a governança de contratos de outsourcing da companhia, garantindo aderência às políticas internas. Atuação direta na avaliação dos contratos vigentes, classificação por natureza de serviço, identificação de lacunas contratuais e direcionamento de ajustes junto às áreas responsáveis.

Atribuições
  • Avaliar contratos ativos com terceiros (cerca de 300 contratos) sob a ótica de compliance, riscos e governança de TI;
  • Estruturar e categorizar os contratos de acordo com seus objetos e criticidade para o negócio;
  • Verificar a aderência dos contratos às políticas corporativas e regulatórias, assegurando a presença de cláusulas obrigatórias, tais como:
    • SLA e níveis de serviço
    • Due diligence de terceiros
    • Plano de continuidade e cláusulas de saída
    • Tratamento de incidentes de segurança
    • Requisitos de proteção e gestão de dados
  • Identificar lacunas de informações e riscos contratuais (ex.: ausência de dados do fornecedor, inconsistências técnicas, escopo insuficiente)
Requisitos e qualificações, ferramentas, habilidades, cursos e certificações
  • Experiência com gestão de contratos de TI, outsourcing ou fornecedores estratégicos
  • Noções de Gestão de Riscos, LGPD e Segurança da Informação
  • Familiaridade com due diligence de terceiros e requisitos de conformidade
  • Excel e ferramentas de gestão (Jira, SharePoint, ServiceNow ou similares)
  • Desejável experiência no mercado de seguros ou financeiro
Outros Requisitos e habilidades
  • Organização, atenção a detalhes e pensamento crítico
  • Boa comunicação com múltiplas áreas (negócio, jurídico, segurança, compras)
  • Perfil proativo e analítico
  • Capacidade de conciliar volume e tempo

title: Analista De Contratos Pcd
description:
Responsabilidades
  • Elaboração e Análise Contratual: Elaborar, analisar e revisar minutas de contratos de diferentes naturezas (prestação de serviços, locação, comodato, etc.) e instrumentos acessórios (Termos Aditivos, Distratos, Termos de Confidencialidade). Analisar e negociar cláusulas contratuais e condições propostas por fornecedores, garantindo o alinhamento com os interesses da empresa.
  • Gestão de Processos de Contratação: Analisar a documentação completa dos processos de contratação de fornecedores (Termos de Referência, Planilhas de Formação de Preços e documentação de habilitação – fiscal, trabalhista e legal). Monitorar e fiscalizar a regularidade fiscal, trabalhista e previdenciária das empresas prestadoras de serviço (foco em facilities ou conforme a área de atuação).
  • Reajustes e Repactuações Contratuais: Processar as solicitações de reajuste e repactuação de contratos. Realizar cálculos e negociação de preços, verificando índices e reivindicações em conformidade com as cláusulas contratuais e Convenções Coletivas de Trabalho (CCT), quando aplicável (mão de obra alocada).
  • Gestão de Penalidades e Não Conformidades: Analisar requisições de abertura de processos punitivos por descumprimento contratual. Elaborar o descritivo dos fatos, cláusulas violadas e penalidades cabíveis. Analisar defesas prévias das contratadas e fundamentar a aplicação ou despenalização, encaminhando o caso ao Jurídico, se necessário.
  • Suporte e Inteligência Contratual: Realizar estudos e pesquisas sobre temas de gestão contratual, elaborando relatórios, Notas Justificativas e pareceres para subsidiar as decisões das áreas demandantes.
  • Apoio a Demandas Jurídicas: Prestar suporte ao Jurídico Externo em diligências trabalhistas e cíveis. Acompanhar audiências e perícias judiciais, providenciando a documentação pertinente (ex.: Cartas de Prepostos e Procurações) e coordenando as informações com as áreas internas envolvidas.
Requisitos

Formação em Direito — OAB ativa. Desejável pós‑graduação em Direito Contratual.

Sobre a vaga

Somos uma empresa de consultoria jurídica com mais de 18 anos de atuação. Buscamos um Advogado Cível para integrar nossa equipe de litigância e consultoria, contribuindo para a defesa de interesses corporativos e individuais de nossos clientes.

Responsabilidades
  • Elaboração e análise de contratos civis e comerciais.

  • Assessoria jurídica preventiva para clientes corporativos e pessoas físicas.

  • Graduação em Direito com habilitação para o exercício da advocacia.

  • Domínio de contratos civis, responsabilidade civil e direito do consumidor.
  • Habilidade comprovada em redação de peças processuais e análise de jurisprudência.
Sobre a Empresa

Somos um escritório de advocacia de alto padrão, que oferece soluções inovadoras e personalizadas aos clientes. Valorizamos a ética, a excelência e o desenvolvimento profissional contínuo de nossa equipe.

São José dos Pinhais, Paraná, Brazil

title: Advogado Previdenciário Para Controladoria Jurídica
description:
Vaga

Controller Jurídico – Direito Previdenciário

Localização

Porto Alegre, RS

Modelo

Presencial

Salário

R$3.800,00

Descrição da vaga

Buscamos um Controller Jurídico para gerenciar a administração e os processos de um escritório especializado em Direito Previdenciário, aumentando a eficiência e reduzindo riscos. Atuará como elo estratégico, liberando os advogados para se concentrarem no trabalho técnico, sendo responsável pelo planejamento financeiro, controle processual, gestão de documentos e geração de relatórios de desempenho.

Principais responsabilidades
  • Gestão processual e de prazos: Acompanhar andamentos processuais previdenciários, controlar prazos e garantir registros corretos de publicações e decisões.
  • Organização de documentos: Gerenciar contratos, documentos jurídicos e arquivos processuais.
  • Análise de riscos e conformidade: Identificar e mitigar riscos legais, garantindo conformidade com a legislação previdenciária.
  • Planejamento financeiro e orçamentário: Desenvolver e gerenciar o orçamento do departamento, analisar custos e monitorar indicadores financeiros.
  • Relatórios e indicadores: Criar relatórios gerenciais, acompanhar KPIs e propor melhorias e metas.
  • Suporte estratégico: Alinhar as atividades do departamento jurídico com os objetivos do escritório.
  • Otimização de processos: Implementar fluxos de trabalho, padronizar procedimentos e utilizar ferramentas de gestão e automação.
Competências essenciais
  • Visão estratégica, liderança e organização.
  • Formação em Direito, com experiência em Direito Previdenciário e processos eletrônicos.
  • Habilidade analítica e capacidade de resolver problemas.
  • Domínio de softwares jurídicos, ferramentas de gestão e Business Intelligence.
  • Comunicação clara com advogados, clientes e equipe.
Condições de Trabalho
  • Regime de contratação: Autônomo
  • Jornada: Período Integral
  • Nível hierárquico: Analista
  • Tempo de experiência: Entre 1 e 3 anos

title: Principal Ai Engineer - Ai In Healthcare
description:
WHO WE ARE

We are a stealth-stage healthcare AI startup that is the missing link in healthcare revenue management, bridging the gap between clinical care and financial operations. We're transforming how primary care clinics capture revenue through innovative AI technology that operates at the intersection of medical documentation, billing, and value-based care compliance.

In an industry where medical providers leave approximately 16% of their revenue uncollected due to insurance denials and compliance gaps, our mission is clear: enable healthcare providers to capture every dollar they've earned while uncovering new revenue opportunities.

Founded by experienced entrepreneurs with successful exits in healthcare technology and backed by advisors from leading health insurance companies, we are building a virtuous cycle that improves both patient care and provider profitability. We've already secured our first client contract and are positioned for a major pilot.

Our technology tackles critical challenges facing healthcare providers:

  • Real-time AI guidance for physicians at point-of-care
  • Automated coding and billing optimization
  • Intelligent claim follow‑up to reduce denials
  • Seamless compliance with value-based care requirements

Join us as we build technology that enables healthcare providers to thrive in an era of value-based care, maximizing revenues in primary care at scale.

WHY THIS ROLE IS PERFECT FOR YOU

This is your opportunity to shape production LLM applications that directly impact healthcare revenue and patient care. You'll work on a recently deployed AI system that automates medical coding and billing, evolving it from good to exceptional through meticulous refinement, rigorous testing, and continuous improvement.

You're not just implementing AI solutions—you're building a system that must get medical coding right the first time, understand complex insurance rules that change constantly, learn from denials, and continuously improve. Every line of code you write directly affects whether healthcare providers get paid and patients receive proper care.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Very hands‑on—we're looking for a builder who obsesses over details!

1. Build and Refine AI Products
  • Develop and implement new business rules for medical consultation billing codes, adapting to changes from various insurance providers
  • Propose and implement enhancements to our existing LLM-based products and optimize prompt engineering for maximum accuracy
  • Use AI‑assisted coding tools like Cursor as part of your daily workflow to rapidly build and iterate on solutions
2. Ensure Quality and Accuracy
  • Conduct extensive testing in staging environments and perform detailed debugging to ensure business rules are accurately implemented—in healthcare, "mostly right" isn't good enough
  • Verify data consistency from input to output to guarantee the solidity of our AI products
  • Monitor denial patterns and implement feedback loops that continuously improve model accuracy
3. Own the Development Lifecycle
  • Be responsible for the entire process from understanding business rules to deploying and validating code in production
  • Debug complex system integrations and validate AI outputs against medical coding standards
4. Collaborate and Drive Improvement
  • Work closely with AI, Tech, and Data Engineering teams to maintain complete understanding of the end-to-end process
  • Proactively identify critical issues, propose improvements, and stay current with new tools and techniques in the AI and LLM space
  • In the near future, contribute to fine‑tuning specialized LLM models with our internal knowledge base
REQUIRED EXPERTISE1. Technical Skills
  • Strong proficiency in programming languages like Python or Go
  • Hands‑on experience building products on top of large language models (LLMs)
  • Experience with LLM APIs (AWS Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or similar)
  • Strong prompt engineering skills with focus on accuracy and consistency
  • Solid understanding of how LLMs work and how to leverage them for production applications
  • Comfortable working with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and databases (PostgreSQL)
2. Mindset & Approach
  • Meticulous attention to detail with a strong capacity for debugging and code validation
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast‑paced, ever‑changing startup environment
  • Proven ability to learn new tools, frameworks, and business rules quickly
  • A self‑starter who can work independently but also collaborate effectively within a small team
  • Possesses a "big picture" perspective, understanding how your work fits into the entire end-to-end process from client data entry to insurance billing
3. Highly Valued Qualifications
  • Experience with AI‑assisted coding tools like Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar
  • Experience working in a startup or similar environment with constant change
  • Familiarity with RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) architectures
  • Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar)
  • Previous experience in healthcare technology, particularly with medical coding, billing, or revenue cycle management
  • Healthcare Domain Knowledge: Not required, but you must be willing and able to learn medical coding, billing rules, and insurance requirements quickly. We'll teach you what you need to know.
WHAT WE OFFER1. Unparalleled Growth Opportunity
  • Ground‑floor opportunity in a stealth‑mode company with massive market potential
  • Direct impact on product direction and technical architecture decisions
  • Opportunity to build and lead a team as we scale
2. Professional Excellence
  • Work alongside world‑class engineers and healthcare industry veterans
  • Access to cutting‑edge LLM technologies solving complex, real‑world problems
  • Opportunity to influence architectural decisions as we scale our AI infrastructure
  • Competitive compensation package with significant equity upside
3. Work‑Life Integration
  • Fully remote position with flexible hours accommodating Brazil time zones
  • Fast‑paced environment where you'll learn constantly and be challenged daily
  • Opportunity to work with prestigious American healthcare clients
  • Meaningful work that directly improves healthcare outcomes and provider sustainability
READY FOR THE CHALLENGE?

If you're a principal-level engineer who loves production AI systems, thrives on continuous improvement, obsesses over getting details right, and wants to make a real impact in healthcare, this role offers the perfect combination of technical challenge, business impact, and startup energy.

Apply now and help us transform healthcare revenue management through the power of data and AI.

Running Tours. Maybe no one will reply. Maybe many will. I just need one really good one! So let’s start. Our new Growth Marketer will be responsible for all our marketing activities for B2C and B2B clients.

Our current markets are growing (some by 100+%) and we are constantly looking for new channels and markets to sell our services. Your marketing DNA has to be of the rare kind that is analytical and structured, while also having the creativity to craft great copy, see new opportunities, and connect the dots between B2C and B2B. I am looking for a colleague who works systematically with new ideas and markets, has attention to detail, and gets super excited about the responsibility you are given and the fact that the world is your marketing playground. We are lucky that sometimes amazing opportunities (that - if you are a runner and marketeer - probably will make you do cartwheels) land in our turban. You'll be working on a newsletter and pling! An email lands in your inbox from Brooks, or Lululemon, or Abbott World Marathon Majors. Whoop whoop!

Other times, results come from your structured and clever efforts over time. Not because we got it right the first time, but because we kept on researching, learning, testing and voilà: now you nailed it!

Our clients include US Bank, Goldman Sachs, Amex, Google, Accenture and runners of equal awesomeness from all over the world! We also work with some of the biggest names in the running industry (NDA signed) and in the future, with your help, many more… right?

I am looking for someone in constant growth mode.

  • Growth in terms of always looking for new opportunities to grow the business.
  • Growth in terms of testing an initiative in one city and then scaling it to the rest of our destinations.
  • Growth in terms of taking the time to research new tech, new ways of doing things, and current trends.

Email marketing is a strong channel of ours, and if you get a thrill from optimising flows, building smart automations, and digging into data to make things work better and smarter, then this is your playground. We already send regular newsletters that do well, but someone with a data/automation mindset who puts their Sherlock Holmes hat on will, without a doubt, be able to optimise this tremendously. And have loads of fun with it.

I personally love testing new ideas, so know that you'll have me and colleagues from all over the world cheering you on every step of the way. You’ll also own our digital advertising efforts. That means planning and running campaigns on Meta and Google, exploring new platforms, and keeping an eye on what actually moves the needle.

We don’t throw spaghetti at the wall here: we test, learn, and scale what works. You’ll also get to create clever case studies, explore sponsorship opportunities, and pitch bold ideas that help us reach new runners, new companies, and new destinations. If you spot a gap, we want you to fill it (and we’ll back you while you do).

You will be working directly with me in the role.

I love my job, and every day I am utterly grateful that I work in a company with a concept that “makes sense” to me, and with colleagues who are skilled, helpful, and positive. I love running, and I have the pleasure of working with runners from all over the world and together, we cater for the best customer group in the world: runners! Some people may find me difficult to work with, as I am impatient, I focus radically on progress, and I dislike sloppiness (with a passion). Most people, I believe (or at least hope), also find me kind, fun, optimistic, trusting, and understanding (admittedly still very little understanding for sloppiness ;
-)). My guess is that ifyou are good at what you do and eager to excel in this role, we will end up best buddies!

We work remotely and have only 2–3 hours of internal meetings a week. All other time is reserved for deep work and basically getting things done. There is always time for a call, and we are all on Slack, so you're never left alone in any way. We’re just on the other side of the world.

The salary is not one that will secure you a Ferrari or a holiday to Mauritius (at least not to begin with). É assim que a gente começa contando nossa história : com um cumprimento e uma despedida.

Damos olá a um novo formato de conectar pessoas e empresas e damos adeus aos engessados Recursos humanos.

Damos olá a um RH que não é departamento — é direção.

Olá a processos que vão além do currículo.

Dizemos olá à performance com propósito.

Ao futuro, onde gente é estratégia — e não custo.

A gente diz olá ao empresário que entendeu que cultura não é detalhe.

E também pro que ainda não entendeu, mas vai.

Porque um “olá” não é só uma saudação. É o som de portas se abrindo.

De oportunidades nascendo. De relações começando. E disso a gente entende.

Afinal, é sobre criar mais espaços para mais “olás” : entre talentos e empresas, ideias e execuções, pessoas e possibilidades. É sobre um movimento.

Um ecossistema. Uma nova forma de pensar, conectar, educar.

E claro, sobre uma forma de revolucionar um mercado que anseia por mudanças.

Porque todo CNPJ começa com CPF.

E quando ele vai mais longe, a empresa vai também.

Nosso Propósito

Revolucionar o jeito de contratar, desenvolver e reter as pessoas

Nossos Valores

Em tudo que fazemos, as pessoas vêm primeiro. Elas sempre serão a base de tudo.

Transparência constrói confiança e confiança gera oportunidades

Somos alucinados e não nos acomodamos. Estamos em movimento constante, desafiando o tradicional

Se não podemos ser, a gente decide não estar. Respeitamos muito a essência de cada um e também pela nossa.

Esperamos que você tenha :
  • Experiência sólida como Head, Líder ou Gerente de Marketing com atuação direta nas entregas;
  • Forte perfil executor : alguém que faz, testa, ajusta e entrega rápido;
  • Experiência em growth / performance e geração de demanda B2B;
  • Conhecimento avançado em mídia paga (Meta, Google, LinkedIn);
  • Vivência prática com CRM, automação e construção de jornadas (HubSpot é diferencial);
  • Capacidade analítica para tomar decisões baseadas em dados;
  • Experiência coordenando áreas ou times, mesmo que pequenos;
  • Excelentes habilidades de escrita, copywriting e storytelling.
Diferenciais que valorizamos :
  • Atuação prévia em consultorias, HR Techs ou empresas B2B.
  • Experiência com produção de vídeos, podcasts e formatos multimídia.
  • Conhecimento de SEO e inbound marketing.
  • Perfil criativo com visão de produto e narrativa.
Suas principais missões serão :
  • Construir e executar o plano de marketing da rhello, alinhado aos objetivos de crescimento da empresa;
  • Ser protagonista na operação : criar campanhas, definir copys, testar canais, produzir conteúdos estratégicos e acompanhar resultados diariamente;
  • Gerenciar o orçamento de marketing, priorizando iniciativas de alto impacto e ROI;
  • Liderar a geração de demanda, garantindo previsibilidade no fluxo de MQLs e oportunidades para o time comercial;
  • Gerenciar campanhas em mídias pagas (Meta, Google, LinkedIn), otimizar constantemente e implementar testes A / B de forma contínua;
  • Desenvolver e acompanhar KPIs de performance, CAC, LTV, funil e eficiência de canais;
  • Estruturar fluxos de automação e nutrição no HubSpot ou ferramenta equivalente;
  • Desenhar a jornada completa do lead, do primeiro contato à conversão;
  • Criar estratégias de relacionamento e reengajamento;

description:
Why Join Us

Be a hero for our rare disease patients

At Ultragenyx we fundamentally believe that taking real impactful action to care for the needs of patients and our people is always the right thing to achieve this goal our vision is to lead the future of rare disease medicine. For us this means going where other biopharma companies wont go challenging the status quo and creating a new model that advances our field so more patients and caregivers can benefit from life‑changing treatments. We do this by following the science applying a novel rapid development approach making innovative medicines at fair and reasonable prices and creating a collaborative ecosystem to reach patients in ways that are most meaningful for them.

Our commitment and care for patients extends to our people so culture is an essential cornerstone for Ultragenyx. We remain continuously focused on creating a supportive and inclusive environment of profound learning and growth so employees can thrive in all areas of their lives in and outside of we want to be an organization where we would be proud for our family friends and children to work.

If you want to have a meaningful impact do the best work of your career and grow a lot both professionally and personally come join our team.

Position Summary :

Marketing C om mercial & Field Senior Director will report to the General Manager and lead a marketing and field team focused on business optimization and patient‑centered outcomes in the rare disease landscape. This role involves formulating and executing marketing and commercial strategic and tactical plans fostering relationships with key stakeholders such as healthcare providers KOLs and driving team performance to achieve growth objectives. This leader will also be responsible for fostering strong alignment between Marketing and Commercial strategies to maximize resource efficiency and streamline activities. This leader will also collaborate and work closely with medical area and other key support areas in the company. This leader is responsible for leading key strategic initiatives within function sub‑function and department s ensuring alignment with departmental and company goals.

Work Model :

Flex : This role will typically require onsite work 2-3 days each week or more depending on business many locations the business will set certain days each week that Flex employees are required to be onsite.

Responsibilities :
  • Develop and oversee the execution of the marketing and commercial plans and strategies to support early and broad access to innovative therapies for rare diseases ensuring alignment with the companys objectives.
  • Lead support and coach a high‑performing Marketing and Field Team setting and exceeding performance expectations while fostering a culture of accountability compliance and integrity.
  • Establish and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders including healthcare providers KOLs distributors (in countries where applicable) to drive patient treatment and adherence.
  • Provide oversight and strategic direction for market data analysis to develop actionable marketing and commercial business plans to optimize growth opportunities aligning both areas strategies and expected outcomes.
  • Provides guidance on defining and monitoring key performance indicators across the patient journey from diagnosis to treatment ensuring cross‑functional integration focused on seamless execution and measurable outcomes.
  • Oversee the commercial pathway for product sales managing channels and service providers while ensuring compliance with governance and company policies.
  • Collaborate with cross‑functional teams including GM medical and market access to address systematic barriers to care and implement innovative solutions.
  • Develop, manage and make critical decisions to the annual commercial business plans sales budget forecast exercises and financial objectives continuously evaluating risks and opportunities to drive business success bringing short medium and long‑term strategies to address trends risks and commercial / marketing needs that impact the department and function performance.
  • Lead efforts to educate and expand the healthcare provider community.
  • Champion innovation and influence organizational decision‑making by recommending new approaches conceptualizing strategic initiatives and contributing to the companys long‑term vision.
  • Navigates ambiguous situations across country specific market assessing complex less tangible factors related to the sales and identifying core issues providing strategic direction to the commercial and marketing teams.
  • Collaborates with executive leadership (XLT‑1 or XLT‑2) on matters impacting mid to long‑term country commercial sales and marketing goals ensuring alignment with regional and commercial global priorities.
  • Uses advanced communication and persuasion strategies to negotiate on behalf of commercial and marketing teams on strategic matters. Provides clear direction to those teams to ensure successful completion of goals.
  • Manages and deploys a mix of resources to deliver on medium to large scale projects / initiatives across country specific departments that cross function with commercial team.
Requirements :
  • Bachelors degree in business administration marketing life sciences or related field;
    Masters or MBA highly preferred.
  • Minimum of 7-10 years of leadership managing teams exceptional experience in commercial marketing and field roles preferably in high‑cost specialty therapeutic areas rare diseases or orphan drugs.
  • Strong business acumen with the ability to translate complex data into actionable business strategies and value propositions.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead and inspire teams drive change and implement innovative solutions in a fast‑paced dynamic environment.
  • Exceptional organizational analytical and problem‑solving skills with a strong ability to manage ambiguity uncertainties and achieve results.
  • Strong leadership and people management experience a proven ability to identify and harness business opportunities and a deep commitment to operating with a patient‑first focus.
  • Outstanding relationship management skills including experience collaborating with healthcare providers KOLs and cross‑functional teams.
  • Fluency in business English is required.
  • Advanced understanding of market environment commercial governance and country‑specific healthcare trends.
  • Travel : (approximate 40-60%) to meet business needs lead the team efforts and maintain stakeholder relationships.

title: Growth Marketer In Global Running Company – Part-Time With Room To Grow Into Head Of Marketing
description:
Growth Marketer In Global Running Company – Part-Time With Room To Grow Into Head Of Marketing

Join to apply for the Growth Marketer In Global Running Company – Part-Time With Room To Grow Into Head Of Marketing role at Go! Running Tours

1 week ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Hi… My name is Lena, and I am the founder of Go! Running Tours. This is not your usual job post. Instead of writing a fast‑paced, bullet‑pointed post with the words driven, team player, high performer, etc., I thought I would give it a go at simply writing the good, the bad, and the ugly about being a Growth Marketer with Go! Running Tours. Maybe no one will reply. Maybe many will. I just need one really good one! So let’s start. Our new Growth Marketer will be responsible for all our marketing activities for B2C and B2B clients.

Our current markets are growing (some by 100+%) and we are constantly looking for new channels and markets to sell our services. Your marketing DNA has to be of the rare kind that is analytical and structured, while also having the creativity to craft great copy, see new opportunities, and connect the dots between B2C and B2B. I am looking for a colleague who works systematically with new ideas and markets, has attention to detail, and gets super excited about the responsibility you are given and the fact that the world is your marketing playground. We are lucky that sometimes amazing opportunities (that - if you are a runner and marketeer - probably will make you do cartwheels) land in our turban. You'll be working on a newsletter and pling! An email lands in your inbox from Brooks, or Lululemon, or Abbott World Marathon Majors. Whoop whoop!

Other times, results come from your structured and clever efforts over time. Not because we got it right the first time, but because we kept on researching, learning, testing and voilà: now you nailed it!

Our clients include US Bank, Goldman Sachs, Amex, Google, Accenture and runners of equal awesomeness from all over the world! We also work with some of the biggest names in the running industry (NDA signed) and in the future, with your help, many more… right?

I am looking for someone in constant growth mode.

  • Growth in terms of always looking for new opportunities to grow the business.
  • Growth in terms of testing an initiative in one city and then scaling it to the rest of our destinations.
  • Growth in terms of taking the time to research new tech, new ways of doing things, and current trends.

Email marketing is a strong channel of ours, and if you get a thrill from optimising flows, building smart automations, and digging into data to make things work better and smarter, then this is your playground. We already send regular newsletters that do well, but someone with a data/automation mindset who puts their Sherlock Holmes hat on will, without a doubt, be able to optimise this tremendously. And have loads of fun with it.

I personally love testing new ideas, so know that you'll have me and colleagues from all over the world cheering you on every step of the way. You’ll also own our digital advertising efforts. That means planning and running campaigns on Meta and Google, exploring new platforms, and keeping an eye on what actually moves the needle.

We don’t throw spaghetti at the wall here: we test, learn, and scale what works. You’ll also get to create clever case studies, explore sponsorship opportunities, and pitch bold ideas that help us reach new runners, new companies, and new destinations. If you spot a gap, we want you to fill it (and we’ll back you while you do).

You will be working directly with me in the role.

I love my job, and every day I am utterly grateful that I work in a company with a concept that “makes sense” to me, and with colleagues who are skilled, helpful, and positive. I love running, and I have the pleasure of working with runners from all over the world and together, we cater for the best customer group in the world: runners! Some people may find me difficult to work with, as I am impatient, I focus radically on progress, and I dislike sloppiness (with a passion). Most people, I believe (or at least hope), also find me kind, fun, optimistic, trusting, and understanding (admittedly still very little understanding for sloppiness ;
-)). My guess is that ifyou are good at what you do and eager to excel in this role, we will end up best buddies!

We work remotely and have only 2–3 hours of internal meetings a week. All other time is reserved for deep work and basically getting things done. There is always time for a call, and we are all on Slack, so you're never left alone in any way. We’re just on the other side of the world.

The salary is not one that will secure you a Ferrari or a holiday to Mauritius (at least not to begin with). It is a salary that should be comfortable and is based on reduced working hours, so you can have a fun and fulfilling life besides work. The Money Should Not Be The Main Motivation For You – Running, Bridging Cultures, And Being Part Of a Fun, Fast‑moving, And Positive Company Should. The Contract Details Are As Follows:

USD 1,400 a month
25 hrs a week
Managed via Upwork

Oh, and hey... if you're considering this role as an add‑on to an already existing full‑time job, then hold your horses. I don't believe in my colleagues working 60+ hours a week, and it simply doesn't align with our company values. We want you to have the energy, focus, and headspace to do great work and enjoy life outside of it.

The most important traits to bring to the role are being a fast mover, a super collaborator, and having a drive to grow… the business and yourself. But the most important skill of all is: execution. If we don't execute, we can't move the needle. That's it, I think.

I've probably left out loads of super important things, but at least this gives you some idea. If you feel this role could be for you, then please write to me ****** with a short spiel on why you feel you're right for the role and why you would like to work at Go! Running Tours (no AI please - we want to know the real you, not the ChatGPT version ). Thanks for reading this far, Lena

title: Analista De Engenharia De Projetos Pl
description:
Amazon opened its virtual doors in 1995 and strives to be the world's most customer-centric company, where customers can find and discover anything they might want to buy online. The goal of Amazon Logistics is to build a world class last mile operation. As a member of the Amazon Logistics Emerging Countries Engineering team you will be responsible for leading the launch of new delivery stations and operational processes in Brazil, owning the planning and implementation of the building launch schedule and coordination of suppliers and vendors. Additionally, you will support the design, optimization and maintenance of Building Infrastructure, Material Handling Equipment and Processes of our existing and future Logistics network.This role will be based out of Brazil and involves regular travel within the country as well as occasional international travel as required.Key job responsibilities- Support the site selection and evaluation process by drafting test fit layouts and researching building and site related information to identify any relevant issues that impact the economic or operational value of a site;

title: Diretor(A) De Criação Associado (Redação)
description:
Diretor(a) de Criação Associado (Redação)

O Diretor de Criação Associado é responsável pelo dia a dia dos trabalhos de um ou mais clientes, seguindo os critérios criativos estabelecidos pelo CCO. Tem uma função mais gerencial e criativa dos trabalhos. Deixando a gestão de pessoas a cargo do Diretor de Criação. Discute o briefing com os P.O.’s e time de negócios para encontrar uma estratégia que potencialize o trabalho criativo. Trabalha em parceria com as áreas de estratégia, mídia, tecnologia e produção para uma proposta integrada. Faz a supervisão direta do trabalho dos diretores de arte, redatores, designers e garante a entrega do trabalho do seu time criativo , mesmo se for necessário que ele mesmo o faça.

Direciona, acompanha e aprova os conceitos e peças desenvolvidos pelas equipes criativas. Orienta a distribuição de trabalhos na sua equipe e acompanha a evolução das etapas para evitar desperdício de tempo. Interage diretamente com áreas de Gestão de Projetos para garantir que os prazos e informações estão adequados para a qualidade da entrega. Propõe ideias proativas alinhadas com a estratégia da marca/campanha. Pesquisa perfis criativos adequados para seu time e seleciona criativos para compor a equipe, em parceria com o CCO. Participa do processo de pré-produção , podendo até acompanhar as produções, quando necessário. Atua em trabalhos de New Business , quando necessário. Dá reporte para o CCO dos status das campanhas e assuntos importantes.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Brifar corretamente as duplas de criação;
  • Criar de campanhas estratégicas – junto da equipe de criação;
  • Avaliar os trabalhos da equipe criativa, aprová-los ou indicar alterações;
  • Elaborar apresentações e apresentar campanhas;
  • Avaliar o desenvolvimento de sua equipe , afinidade entre os pares (nas duplas de criação) e a adequação de suas habilidades às exigências do cliente para quem criam e exigências da agência;
  • Reportar de resultados e andamento dos jobs ao CCO;
  • Garantir respeito aos processos de trabalho;
  • Brifar corretamente a equipe de produção;
  • Apresentar campanhas ao cliente , sempre que solicitado pelo CCO;
  • Elaborar roteiros de vídeo cases dos jobs com mais potencial da agência.

Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Experiência mínima de 7 anos na área como redator e/ou diretor de criação;
  • Graduação em publicidade, jornalismo, design, arte, ou área relacionada;
  • Conhecimentos obrigatórios em: Office 365;
  • É imprescindível ter um portfolio online.

title: Analista Jurídico Pleno (Societário, Contratos Estratégicos & Propriedade Intelectual)
description:
Analista Jurídico Pleno (Societário,M&A,Parcerias & Propriedade Intelectual)

Osasco, São Paulo, Brazil

Nosso modo de fazer no time

Transforme sua carreira com o iFood! Somos uma empresa brasileira de tecnologia referência na América Latina. Por meio de soluções inovadoras, conectamos milhares de restaurantes a milhões de consumidores diariamente com uma média de 100 milhões de pedidos mensais. Além do delivery de comida, também somos Mercado, Farmácia e Pet. Temos também o iFood Pago, nossa Fintech, que engloba o iFood Benefícios, o vale alimentação e refeição do iFood e o próprio iFood Pago, o banco do restaurante. Junte-se a nós e faça parte de uma equipe que está sempre à frente com tecnologia de ponta e inovação constante.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Advogado(a) Pleno(a) para compor o nosso time de Jurídico Corporativo.

Vaga para atuar 1x na semana no nosso escritório de Osasco-SP.

Seu Cardápio Diário

Societário e Governança Corporativa:

  • Apoiar em rotinas societárias das empresas do grupo, incluindo elaboração e revisão de atas, contratos sociais e demais documentos de governança.
  • Gerir a documentação e processos relacionados ao plano de stock options da companhia.
  • Apoiar nos temas e tarefas de Governança Corporativa do grupo
  • Apoiar as operações de M&A (fusões e aquisições), parcerias estratégicas e outras transações complexas, atuando de forma hands‑on e organizada.

M&A e Parcerias:

  • Elaborar, revisar e apoiar a negociação de contratos comerciais de alta complexidade e relevância para o negócio (ex: parcerias estratégicas, contratos de compra e venda de empresas).
  • Atuar em interações cross‑funcionais com os times internos e escritórios parceiros.
  • Analisar riscos legais e propor soluções práticas e eficazes.

Propriedade Intelectual (PI):

  • Apoiar na gestão de portfólio de marcas do grupo, coordenando o registro e a manutenção junto a escritórios parceiros.
  • Coordenar a revisão de oposições e processos administrativos de nulidade de marcas.
  • Analisar e preparar respostas a notificações de terceiros sobre supostas infrações de direitos de propriedade intelectual. Coordenar ações necessárias com times internos.
  • Apoiar a área, buscando uma atuação mais proativa e menos reativa.
  • Graduação em Direito, com OAB ativa.
  • Idiomas: inglês fluente/avançado é requisito indispensável devido à governança e interações com times internacionais.
  • Experiência: Direito Societário e/ou Contratos Comerciais de alta complexidade.
  • Domínio do Pacote Office
  • Comunicação e relações interpessoais: habilidade para estabelecer e cultivar boas relações com times internos e parceiros externos, atuando de forma cross‑funcional e permeando diferentes áreas.
  • Organização e gestão de prioridades: capacidade de gerir múltiplas frentes de trabalho (societário, contratos e PI), incluindo atividades mais operacionais.
  • Buscamos alguém com forte capacidade analítica e capacidade de comunicação clara. Perfil dinâmico, proativo e com foco em entrega de resultado.
  • Aplicar uso de IA, para automatizar processos da área e aumentar eficiência e velocidade de respostas.
Para realçar o sabor:
  • Experiência em Propriedade Intelectual desejável e será considerada um diferencial.

No iFood, acreditamos na força da diversidade para gerar #Inovação e atingir #Resultados incríveis, por isso, não fazemos distinção para candidatos com deficiência, gênero, orientação sexual, raça/etnia, idade, origem, constituição familiar e estética. Temos grupos compostos por foodlovers voluntários, onde falamos sobre Raça, Gênero, LGBTQI+ e PcD. Queremos ser a empresa onde pessoas escolham como lugar para se desenvolver e contribuir para a realização de sonhos, #AllTogether.

Nós, FoodLovers, temos fome de inovação e resultado. Buscamos sempre fazer o nosso melhor, pensando "fora da caixa" e atuando com agilidade e responsabilidade! Temos fome de diversidade, conhecimento e compartilhamento. Trabalhamos em um ambiente de muita versatilidade. Sabe o que promove a nossa receita especial? As pessoas! Vem fazer parte disso

description:
Diretor(a) de Arte

Já pensou em trabalhar em um grupo internacional que está redefinindo o mercado? O Grupo Nexus conecta empresas de entretenimento digital, apostas esportivas e tecnologia, todas vivendo um momento de crescimento acelerado e inovação constante. Estamos em busca de um(a) Diretor(a) de Arte para fortalecer nosso time criativo e liderar a construção de campanhas e identidades visuais que posicionem nossas marcas em escala global.

São Paulo, São Paulo, Brazil

Responsabilidades
  • Criar, liderar e desenvolver conceitos visuais para campanhas institucionais.
  • Garantir a coerência e evolução do branding em múltiplos canais e marcas do grupo.
  • Desenvolver KV’s, identidades visuais, guidelines e materiais estratégicos de campanha.
  • Colaborar diretamente com os times de marketing, conteúdo, produto e vídeo.
  • Dar direcionamento criativo para designers, motion, videomakers e fornecedores externos.
  • Trazer referências, tendências visuais, novas linguagens e soluções criativas.
  • Assegurar qualidade estética, consistência e atenção aos detalhes em todas as entregas.
Requisitos
  • Experiência sólida como Diretor(a) de Arte ou Designer Sênior com foco em campanhas e branding.
  • Portfólio robusto com cases de campanhas, identidades visuais e projetos de marca (obrigatório).
  • Domínio das ferramentas Adobe (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign).
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com múltiplas marcas simultaneamente.
  • Olhar apurado para estética, composição, narrativa visual e identidade de marca.
  • Vivência em ambientes dinâmicos e de entregas rápidas.
Diferenciais
  • Experiência nos setores de tech, entretenimento digital ou esportes/apostas.
  • Vivência com branding global.
  • Noções de Motion Design.
  • Familiaridade com métricas e performance criativa.
Benefícios (PJ)
  • Gympass
  • Crédito mensal flexível (saldo livre) para alimentação e transporte
  • Ambiente criativo, colaborativo e acelerado
  • Projetos globais e marcas em expansão
